articleTitle: Beyond Boundaries: Progressive Health Monitoring For Paralysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This initiative's main goal is to design a healthcare system specifically for people who are paralyzed. These people frequently struggle to communicate their requirements because of speech impairments and lack of control over their muscles, which includes the muscles used for sign language. In order to overcome this difficulty, our suggested system makes communication easier by using a touch sensor interface to inform caregivers through IOT platform Blynk or by displaying messages on an LCD screen. Touching designated places on the touch sensors (each of which corresponds to a coded message) allows the user to communicate particular messages to the caregiver. With the help of this touch-triggered communication system, caregivers may promptly attend to the paralyzed person's requirements and guarantee that they are effectively communicated. The automated patient care system for paralysis improves the quality of care provided overall, which benefits the patient. The addition of a Node MCU ESP 8266 and the Blynk app improves the system's emergency response even more, resulting in a comprehensive and efficient healthcare solution for people who are paralyzed. A Blynk application and a Node MCU ESP 8266 are effortlessly integrated by the system. With the help of this cutting-edge technology, caregivers can receive real-time messages instantly, guaranteeing a prompt reaction in emergency situations. In addition to meeting the patient's immediate requirements, this coordinated communication strategy fosters an atmosphere that is beneficial to their general health and wellbeing.

articleTitle: Sign Language Prediction Using Eight-Layered CNN for Deaf and Dumb
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: American Sign Language is a hand sign language that allows two people to communicate completely by moving their hands together. This sign language is useful for mute and deaf individuals to communicate about their situations with others when they are in trouble. In this present era of enhanced mobile technology, using a camera to capture video or images is substantially simpler. Others can record their hand gestures using a mobile phone and understand their problem. This study proposes an affordable method to detect American Sign Language (ASL) using an image dataset. In this paper “Finger Spelling, A” dataset has been employed, having 24 letters (excluding j and z as they include movements). The primary factor for selecting this option dataset is that these images exhibit a complex backdrop with varied backdrops and background colours. Several research articles have been conducted on the prediction of sign language based on static images. The most often used prediction algorithms based on convolutional neural networks (CNN). This paper examined the multi layered CNN on hand sign language recognition. This study also looked at other research endeavors and emphasized the pertinent benefits and downsides.

articleTitle: Optimizing Leukemia Classification Through Nature-Inspired Feature Reduction and Stacked Ensemble Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Leukemia, a complex and heterogeneous group of hematologic malignancies, presents significant challenges in accurate diagnosis and classification. In this work, an innovative approach to optimize leukemia classification using nature-inspired feature reduction approaches and stacked ensemble learning algorithms is proposed. Microarray data, a rich source of genetic information, often suffer from high dimensionality, making it challenging to extract meaningful features for classification. To address this, we employ nature-inspired algorithms such as Genetic Algorithm (GA), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO), and Hunger Search Method (HSM) to reduce data dimensionality while preserving important features. Subsequently, we explore the efficacy neural network, including Deep Neural Networks (DNN) and stacked ensemble models, for classification tasks. Our test results show that, in comparison to conventional techniques, the suggested strategy considerably increases the accuracy of the leukaemia classification. Moreover, stacked ensemble models outperform individual classifiers, highlighting the efficiency of combining diverse models for improved classification performance. Overall, our study contributes to advancing precision medicine by providing a robust framework for optimizing leukemia classification through the combination of nature-inspired feature reduction and stacked ensemble learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Real-Time Vehicle Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: There's no fixed bus schedule and the transportation system isn't reliable, the people can't figure out whether the nus have arrived or not. By informing each other is difficult to know the timings and the bus schedule is a bit unpredictable. The existing methodologies only track a particular bus, but our system aims to track the each and every public transportation by giving the bus number and then also by tracking the bus by giving the source and the destination address in the mobile application. By this application the timings and then the location of the particular bus and the number of buses in that particular route will be tracked and monitored by the passenger.

articleTitle: Human Computer Interaction for Disabled People Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) strategies encompass a range of methods and techniques designed to facilitate seamless interactions between people and computers. In the past, the mouse and keyboard have been used as input devices in human computer interference systems. The primary goal of developing this application is to specifically enhance HCI for individuals with disabilities. The focus lies in empowering users to control the cursor using eyes, eliminating the need for hand control. The application uses Parallel-Convolutional Neural Network approach to accomplish the cursor control using eye. In addition, the eye-tracking mechanism is further im-proved by guaranteeing reliable and precise cursor control within the Dynamic Questions Window. The application opens up new possibilities for people with impairments, and provides a chance to actively engage with computers, and the ability to participate in performing of the movement of cursor.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Credit Card Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The introduction and availability of credit cards in the modern world have transformed the transaction or payment process from the typical cash payment to modernized cashless payment. Due to the rapid growth and development of e-commerce platforms and improved accessibility to the Internet, a notable increase in the use of credit cards for purchases has occurred. Regrettably, this surge has also been accompanied by an upswing in fraudulent activities, demanding heightened vigilance. The phrase “credit card fraud” describes a wide rangeof illicit actions in which individuals utilize credit card details to get money through deception. Effectively combating this multifaceted threat necessitates a deep understanding of the mechanisms involved in identifying and preventing credit card fraud. Since sophisticated techniques for preventing and detecting fraud have been developed over time, the effects of credit card fraud have decreased, and the sector has become more stable. While previous research in this field has largely depended on machine learning algorithms such as random forest and logistic regression for credit card fraud detection, this study introduces a groundbreaking approach. We present the use of convolutional Neural network (CNN) models, a method commonly used in image processing and image recognition, to evaluate heatmaps generated from credit card transaction data.

articleTitle: 1 AI-Powered Facial Expression Analysis In Real Time: Unveiling Emotions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)

authors.preferredName: Penmatsa V P S Akhilesh Varma

abstract: This study introduces a novel facial deconstruction method for face emotion identification. After identifying facial landmarks with the IntraFace algorithm, seven regions of interest (ROI) are extracted, representing the principal featuresof the face: the mouth, nose, an area between the eyebrows, right and left eyes, and eyebrows. Next, a variety of local descriptors, such as Local Binary Patterns, Completed Local Binary Patterns. Local Ternary Patterns, and Dynamic Local Ternary Patterns, are employed to capture distinctive features. Inputting the feature vector which represents a face image into a multi-class support vector machine completes the recognition process. The suggested method outperforms previous facial deconstruction techniques, according on experimental findings on two publicly available datasets.

articleTitle: Emerging Technologies in Online Learning with New Trends and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: To better understand the state of e-learning and direct future research, guidance work is required. Recent research indicates that e-learning environments have been classified under many labels. The primary motivation behind adding these additional subtopics is to provide a more recent description of e-learning in this area. Micro-credentials, artificial intelligence, virtual reality, big data, blended, mobile, and cloud e-learning, the Internet of Things, gamification, and online video will be analyzed as emerging technologies in online education. The purpose of this research is to provide clarity around the idea of online education. E-learning also emphasizes expanding students' horizons. New adversarial ideas emerge daily in online classrooms. These novel ideas spread fast throughout society and became crucial teacher resources. Recent online education settings are being employed as interconnected platforms. Fundamentally, they believe in the potential of online education. The percentage of applications of the recent trends are analyzed as follows: Micro-credentials:15-20%, AI:20-25%, Big Data: 20-25%, Blended Learning: 30-40%, Mobile Learning: 25-30%, Cloud E-Learning:30-35%, Internet of Things (IoT): 5-10%, Gamification: 15-20%.

articleTitle: Predictive Factors Influencing Discharge Destination Following Spinal Cord Injury
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: SCI is a crippling illness that can significantly lower a person's quality of life. The severity and location of the injury determine the extent of functional disability experienced by the patient. Consequently, SCI patients often require an extended hospital stay for both acute care and rehabilitation. In our research, we have proposed the use of Gradient boosting, a machine learning algorithm, to accurately predict the likelihood of specific events. This algorithm constructs a series of models, each aiming to correct the errors of the previous one. Gradient boosting has shown promise in forecasting a number of outcomes, such as the location of discharge following a spinal cord injury. To predict the likelihood of SCI patients being released to non-routine settings, like long-term acute care hospitals or skilled nursing institutions, we used a gradient boosting technique in our study. Our model incorporated several predictive factors, including injury severity, level of injury, completeness of injury, age, social support, and insurance coverage. Impressively, our model achieved a commendable level of accuracy in predicting the discharge destination.

articleTitle: Analysis of an Intelligent and Cybersecurity Optimization Model for Financial Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Recently, machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) techniques have been mainly applied to manage and secure data in the various sectors of financial enterprises. Several countries have developed their cyber regimes by applying these soft computing techniques to identify the attacks and threats in running the businesses. Cyber security (CS) applications are developed to detect network intrusion, and still, there are some research gaps in adopting these techniques in some countries. This research explores applying the qualitative and quantitative methods and the issues in implementing the new CS model to manage and promote financial and business growth. This research focuses on developing a new ML model for the business and financial data protection distribution around CS. This research's primary and secondary data collection analyzes that the proposed model behaves well compared to the existing potential CS packages with high-level adoption in business enterprises. Based on the policies and collaborations proposed by the governments, the research model minimizes the risks, threats, and attacks in the small and medium -scale business and financial sectors. The model rightly balances the impact and risk versus cost and productivity impact in securing from cyber threats and attacks. The system vulnerabilities are reduced to less than 3 %. The mean detection time is less than 5 milliseconds, and the mean response time is less than 3 milliseconds. The higher access users range from 1250 to 2500. The expected absolute error lies between 1 % and 5%, and the model's accuracy lies between 92% and 96%.

articleTitle: Cryptographically Secured Data Transmission Over a Network with NetCAT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This study focuses on cryptically secure data trans-mission on a network with NetCAT and emphasizes the improvement of the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm to improve data security. It specifically addresses file encryption using the modified AES and uses the flexibility of NetCAT utility for safe transfer. In particular, the deliberate transformation of intercepted data into incomprehensible gibberish emphasizes the robustness of modified AES against potential surveillance and unauthorized access. This document presents an improved and practical approach to improving data protection during trans-mission, especially in the context of encrypted data transmission through a network with NetCAT. Through the discussion of this specific topic, it contributes significantly to the evolving field of cryptography and emphasizes the need for accurate specifications and a clear focus on the treatment of data security challenges.

articleTitle: Peak Pattern Classification in Mass Spectrometer Data using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Mass spectrometry is a powerful analytical tool that measures the mass-to-charge ratio (m/q) of ions. Its applications span diverse fields, from environmental analysis on Earth to deciphering planetary atmospheres in space missions. CHandra's Atmospheric Composition Explorer-2 (CHACE-2) is a neutral gas mass spectrometer deployed on the Chandrayaan-2 orbiter, identifies the lunar exosphere's composition by analyzing the m/q ratios of collected gas samples. However, manually interpreting these mass spectra to pinpoint specific elements is time-consuming. This study presents deep learning techniques, particularly ID Convolutional Neural Networks (ID CNNs) and a ID CNN-Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) hybrid model, to automate peak pattern identification. CNNs demonstrate particular proficiency in extracting local features within the data, while LSTMs capture temporal dependencies. By leveraging deep learning, this approach offers significant potential for rapid and accurate identification of specific peak patterns in mass spectrometer data.

articleTitle: Smart Helmet with Pollution Reduction System, Accident Detection and Alerting System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: In light of the escalating issues arising from the increasing presence of 2-wheel motor vehicles in densely populated cities despite regulations on engine standards and maintenance, the streets often witness vehicles emitting noxious, malodorous dark smoke. Additionally, the use of leaded gasoline-diesel blends in four-wheeler engines poses health hazards. While ISO-certified full-face helmets are recommended for safety, they can be physically exhausting and uncomfortable for long rides, potentially exposing riders to polluted air. Furthermore, a rising trend in motorcycle accidents is frequently attributable to factors like helmet non-compliance, delayed accident reporting, late hospital admissions, and intoxication. The statistics are stark, with hundreds of thousands of young individuals visiting emergency rooms each year and tens of thousands requiring extended hospital stays. In 2021, the National Crime Records Bureau of India reported a staggering 1,55,622 road accident fatalities, with two-wheelers involved in 44.5 percent of these incidents, particularly concentrated in Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh. To address these complex challenges comprehensively, the proposal advocates for the development of a smart helmet integrating a pollution reduction system, accident detection and alerting system. This aims to significantly alleviate the adverse effects of air pollution and reduce the incidence and severity of motorcycle accidents, ultimately enhancing the safety and well-being of daily commuters in congested urban landscapes as well as long rides.

articleTitle: ThermAI: Exploring Temperature Analysis Through Diverse Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Meteorological forecasting is crucial in multiple industries, including agriculture, aviation, and daily routines. The objective of this inquiry is to improve temperature predictions by examining and comparing several machine learning methods, such as linear regression, decision trees, and random forests. This work aims to fill the gap in assessing machine learning models for temperature forecasting on a broader scale by utilising the comprehensive Indian meteorological dataset, which covers a wide range of geographical regions. The research utilises a thorough technique that includes gathering data, selecting relevant features, choosing appropriate models, and evaluating the results using R-squared and Mean Square Error metrics. The findings demonstrate that the Random Forest model surpasses both multiple linear regression and decision trees in terms of performance, displaying superior accuracy and reduced prediction errors. This study enhances proactive weather management and decision-making processes by offering valuable insights and tools to stakeholders in various industries. The work is organised into distinct sections that encompass a literature review, methodology, results, and conclusions, providing a comprehensive viewpoint on developments in temperature forecasting.

articleTitle: Broccoli Classification: A Fusion of CNN and AdaBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Although precision farming has been introduced, differentiation of crop species still calls for the development of quick and reliable classification tools used in the process of optimizing cultivation practices, which ultimately boost crop yields. Here we propose a new classification method to identify broccoli varieties particularly of ‘Pusa KTS-1’, ‘Green Magic’, and ‘Calabrese’ with the use of an integrated approach that fuses the strength of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and AdaBoost. This research makes a striking improvement in the accuracy of crop variety classification using the fusion of CNN for powerful feature extraction and AdaBoost which leverages the hard instances to increase the accuracy of the classifier. A database of broccoli images was prepared, auxiliary operations were performed and its diversity was improved to make the model not weak and generalized enough. On this dataset, the CNN-AdaBoost ensemble was trained, validated, and tested and the model achieved an overall accuracy of 93.7% which outperformed standalone models. The model's performance at boundaries validates its potential for automatic classification, which is important for precision agriculture's targets of higher productivity and efficiency. The results of this research consequently transcend beyond the scope of broccoli variety classification, lending ways for improvements in agricultural technologies through the adoption of machine learning. In the future, the model will be applied to other crops and will be used to solve many agricultural problems. Its parameters will be improved to make it more convenient for daily use.

articleTitle: A Unified Deep Learning Approach for Lung Segmentation in X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The X-ray images are an affordable means to diagnose the diseases especially the cardio vascular diseases. Chest X-rays are even examined by modern doctors to identify the disease and cure them accordingly. Due to opacified nature of the X-Ray images and different morphology of human body, the lung segmentation of human chest becomes very tedious. In this paper, we have introduced an approach to overcome this limitation and achieve the art-of-state lung segmentation despite of different anatomy and opacity. The approach involves division formula based on U-Net. The used the previously trained models MobileNetV2 and InceptionResNetV2. The result acquired shows the increase in the efficiency of segmentation by 2.5% with respect to Dice score and 2.37% with respect to IoU when compared it with the tradition U-Net.

articleTitle: SentiSense: Pioneering Mental Health Application Through Advanced Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Identifying the factors that contribute to mental health related problems: stress, depression, anxiety, and developing effective therapeutic strategies are essential. Five algorithms(Support Vector Machine, Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree & Neural Network) will be used to classify students into distinct mental health categories based on data obtained from students at a higher education institution. In order to improve student mental health assistance and targeted interventions, the study intends to: Develop precise models for categorizing the mental health conditions of students; Determine the best algorithm for each category (stress, depression, and anxiety); and Provide data-driven insights. This research offers institutions evidence-based strategies for addressing mental health issues, which has the potential to greatly increase student well-being and academic success.

articleTitle: Enhancing Financial Security: A Multimodal Approach to User Authentication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The Digital India initiative not only raises awareness about the benefits of digitization but also underscores the importance of a secure authentication system to combat online fraud. In this study, we propose a multimodal approach integrating audio and image modalities, along with real-time lip-sync detection, to address the issue of unauthorized account usage. The combined utilization of these modalities proves beneficial, particularly in regions with poor internet connectivity. The decision to grant access to a specific individual is dependent upon the combined score derived from both modalities. Furthermore, to enhance security, real-time lip-sync detection (with the help of a synchronization module) is employed to ensure that no prerecorded image or audio is presented during system login access. The synchronization model outperforms the LRS2 dataset and is used for multimodal verification tasks on the GRID dataset with corrupted data to give an EER of 1.44 %.

articleTitle: Home Energy Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The increasing demand for residential energy consumption has prompted the need for innovative solutions to minimize environmental impact and reduce electricity costs. This paper proposes a Home Energy Management System (HEMS) that leverages Internet of Things (IoT) sensors to optimize temperature control within homes. The primary objective is to promote energy-efficient cooling by substituting traditional air conditioners with exhaust fans, thus mitigating the associated electricity consumption. The system incorporates IoT temperature sensors strategically placed within the living space to continuously monitor ambient conditions. Real-time data is collected and processed to determine the optimal cooling requirements. When cooling is needed, the HEMS triggers exhaust fans strategically installed throughout the home, utilizing natural ventilation to maintain a comfortable indoor environment

articleTitle: Advancements in Generative AI: Exploring Fundamentals and Evolution
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative field with far-reaching implications across various domains. This review manuscript provides a advancements in generative AI, focusing on its fundamental concepts, methodologies, and evolutionary trends. We begin by elucidating the foundational principles underlying generative AI techniques, including autoregressive models, Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). Subsequently, we delve into the evolution of generative AI, discussing recent advancements, challenges, and potential future directions. Through an in-depth analysis of research literature and real-world applications, this manuscript aims to offer insights into the current landscape of generative AI and its profound impact on diverse sectors.

articleTitle: Design of Star-Shaped Antenna for Next Generation Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: 5G networks have arrived as a boon for drastically increasing need for higher data speeds and wider bandwidths. The 5G networks are expected to provide ubiquitous connectivity, higher throughput and very high speed data transfer. However, there is a need pressing need for antennas with smaller profile for 5G as the mobile terminals have to be backwards compatible with earlier generations of mobile technology and support many other contemporary services. In light of this, we propose a star-shaped antenna on a 0.5mm thick substrate with a hexagonal profile having sides that are 5 mm each. The antenna is excited through coaxial feed. The antenna resonates at around 28 GHz with an operating bandwidth of 20.5 GHz and a modest gain that is slightly more than 6 dB in the forward plane. The antenna is highly directional with a front-to-back ratio of 14.54 dB. The antenna is found compatible for 5G applications.

articleTitle: ProctorXam - Online Exam Proctoring Tool
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Robust exam monitoring solutions are now essential in light of the most notable Covid-19 outbreak and the increasing inclination towards virtual learning. The automated method for supervising online exams that is suggested in this paper is intended to lessen the difficulties associated with exam cheating. With the assistance of our system's clever face detection algorithms, instructors may efficiently identify suspicious conduct by monitoring students' web activity and camera feed in real-time. Unlike earlier systems, ours provides improved accuracy and functionality, guaranteeing the authenticity of online tests. In light of the difficulties presented by the epidemic, this research attempts to offer a workable option for academic institutions and people wishing to administer fair and secure online exams.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Based EV Charging Station Employed with Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The growing popularity of electric cars (EVs) has made it necessary to build a reliable and effective EV charging infrastructure utilizing machine learning techniques. Optimizing the efficiency and dependability of EV charging infrastructure is largely dependent on power electronics and control techniques. An in-depth review of recent developments in power electronics and control schemes used in EV charging infrastructure is given in this study. This study explores the field of power electronics and control schemes used in infrastructure for EV charging.

articleTitle: Performance Characterization of a Circular Microstrip Patch Antenna Array with Dual Radiating Slots for Wearable Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: A dual element circular microstrip patch antenna array is designed for wearable applications. The utilization of a polyimide substrate is explored, offering flexibility and lightweight properties ideal for conformal integration with wearable devices. The proposed antenna array aims to address the challenges posed by the dynamic and compact nature of wearable systems while ensuring efficient wireless communication in 5.5 GHz. The design process involves the selection of the polyimide substrate material and the systematic development of circular antenna elements with slot structures to achieve desired radiation characteristics. The dual slotted circular antenna array is optimized to enhance directivity and minimize mutual coupling between elements, ensuring a stable and efficient WLAN communication link for wearable devices. The antenna provides low return loss of -10.62 dB, good gain of 7.29 dB and directivity of 7.49 dB, making it suitable for wearable WLAN applications.

articleTitle: Image Classification of Hyperspectral Images using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: In the realm of hyperspectral imagery, sophisticated classification is imperative for extracting nuanced insights from complex data. This paper presents a comprehensive exploration of hyperspectral image classification techniques applied to the Pavia University dataset. Two methods, least squares regression and Lasso regression, were employed to untangle and comprehend spectral information in the study. A thorough analysis of classifier performance was conducted using various methods, including Naive Bayes, Minimum Euclidean Distance, K-Nearest Neighbors, Bayesian classifiers, and a finely tuned SVM model. The fine-tuning process involved exhaustive grid search and cross-validation, resulting in optimized hyperparameters that significantly boosted the SVM model's predictive capabilities. Notably, the introduction of the SVM model for benchmarking unveiled its superior performance, achieving an accuracy of 94.73%, reinforcing the robustness of hyperspectral classification. The findings highlight the effectiveness of the fine-tuned model in capturing spectral nuances and improving classification accuracy, contributing valuable insights to hyperspectral data analysis for applications in remote sensing and environmental monitoring.

articleTitle: Road Traffic Accident Prediction in India Using Machine Learning Algorithm Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Despite fact that vehicle manufacturing has numerous opportunities to design and build shelter structures, road accidents are inevitable. There are numerous accidents in both urban and rural areas. Patterns associated with various situations can be identified by developing reliable prediction models capable of automatically distinguishing distinct unintentional instances. This study aims to develop a robust predictive model for road traffic accidents in India, employing both linear and nonlinear modeling approaches. This paper analyses and predicts road traffic accidents (RTAs) in India using linear, non-linear regression analysis and Multilayer perceptron Neural Networks (MLPNNs), which policymakers can use. It also helps researchers and the field of transportation safety. MLPNN is an advanced technology that has shown great promise in studying ancient data and forecasting forthcoming inclinations. Many predictive models for forecasting the amount of highway accidents have been developed using 26 years of data from 1994 to 2019 for accident counts on India's freeway roads. The best non-linear regression models and MLPNN model was designated for this challenge, with model variables including years and total number of road accidents (in numbers). Performance of the model was contrasted with that of a linear and non-linear regression model developed with the same goal. The findings demonstrate the superiority of the MLPNN model as a forecasting model, with predictions that are reasonably close to forecasting future highway traffic. The study seeks to identify the model that provides superior accuracy and generalization capabilities for road traffic accident prediction, thereby contributing to the development of more effective safety measures and traffic management strategies.

articleTitle: Analysis of Data Extraction Techniques on Medical Health Records
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Extracting cancer-related information from unstructured text presents challenges that require accurate identification and extraction techniques. This study compares three methods: keyword-based matching, regular expression pattern matching, and deep learning-based approaches. The study proposes evaluation metrics including file comparison, cosine similarity, and k-means clustering with Jaccard similarities. The findings demonstrate that the deep learning- based approach achieves the highest accuracy of 99.06%, outperforming the keyword-based (34.27%) and regular expression methods (93.58%).

articleTitle: VisionBlend: Empowering Object Recognition for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: People who are blind or visually impaired face several challenges daily. They are more prone to collide, which can cause severe accidents. Obstacles such as furniture, people, and uneven ground can make it difficult for blind individuals to navigate in crowded or unknown settings. It is crucial to develop a method to prevent such accidents. To overcome all these problems, VisionBlend Empowering Object Recognition for the Visually Impaired is proposed. The suggested solution increases blind people's mobility and safety by combining computer vision, ultrasonic sensors, and real-time aural feedback. The system detects obstacles and recognizes them using computer vision and estimates the distance between obstacles. The proposed system is almost 93% accurate.

articleTitle: From Field to Data: A Machine Learning Approach to Classifying Celery Varieties
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This study investigates a comprehensive scheme that incorporates Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) for the classification of celery types, that is, ‘Pusa Jyoti’, ‘Utah’, and ‘Pusa Lehar’. Leveraging on the joint of CNN for feature extraction and KNN for identification of crop varieties harnesses the advantage of both algorithms intending to increase the precision of crop identification which is an essential component of precision agriculture that further improves crop management, yield quality, and sustainability. The paper puts forward a complete methodology for data preparation and cleaning, model configuration and tuning, and lastly model evaluation. The results of the experiments with a fully integrated CNN - KNN model are appraised using metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, which show that the performance is substantially better than the traditional methods. The research shows clearly the model's power to categorize celery species accurately, however, a comparative analysis with the existing state-of-the-art model has been done and the results show the superiority of the model. The investigation of this study goes beyond the mere academic contribution, it can serve to provide knowledge that applies to agricultural technology; hence farmers, agronomists, and the whole of the agricultural supply chain can benefit. While the research faced challenges that included developing comprehensive datasets that are easily available and numerous, this study provided a foundation for future studies and possible implementation of other machine learning algorithms that aim at improving the accuracy and applicability of the model to other crop types.

articleTitle: Development and Control of Mobile Manipulator - Four-Wheeled Drive Mobile Robot with a 3-DoF Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: In this piece of work we present the development and control of a mobile manipulator - fourwheel drive mobile robot with a three degrees-of-freedom (DoF) manipulator. The parameter of the wheel actuator system are experimentally identified and the gains of PI controller are tuned in offline with the identified model. The velocity kinematics of the four-wheel drive mobile robot is developed. A path-tracking control system is designed using the developed kinematics model of the mobile robot. The path-tracking control system uses the wheel unit encoders in the feedback to estimate the motion of the mobile robot. A position kinematics of three DoF manipulator with a shoulder offset is derived using geometric approach. The trajectory of manipulator's end-effector is controlled using inverse position kinematics. The developed control system is experimentally evaluated with possible maneuverability. From the result it can be inferred that path tracking of the mobile platform was successfully implemented with a maximum error of 1.41%.

articleTitle: Student Answer Script Evaluation Using Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This research proposes a novel approach to assess the quality of summaries written by students. This will assist teachers in evaluating the quality of student summaries and also help learning platforms provide immediate feedback to students. Evaluating summaries introduces an added layer of complexity, where models must consider both the student's context and the actual text. Although there are a handful of current techniques for summary evaluation, these models have often focused on assessing automatically-generated summaries rather than real student writing. Students rarely have enough opportunities to practice this skill, as evaluating and providing feedback on summaries can be a time-intensive process for teachers. Large Language Models are foundational machine learning models that use deep learning algorithms to process and understand natural language. These models are trained on massive amounts of text data to learn patterns and entity relationships in the language. Students will have more opportunities to practice summarizing, while simultaneously improving their reading comprehension.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Performance of the Customized ANN Model for Accurate Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The rise of population in medical research, caused early identification of diseases has become a crucial concern in recent times. The significant increase in the global population has directed a notable rise in the deceased attributed to breast cancer, which is currently recognized as the second most severe type of cancer. To aid healthcare professionals in disease diagnosis and provide them with reliable, efficient, and prompt responses, a system has been developed for automated illness detection. In this particular research investigation, Artificial Neural Network performed breast cancer classification. In order to evaluate the model's performance, a known dataset -UCI machine learning source was utilized. The results indicated that ANN s achieved an exceptional accuracy rate of 98.24%.

articleTitle: Vision-Powered Cursor Maneuvering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This paper presents an eye gaze tracking system aimed at facilitating computer access for physically challenged individuals, particularly those with amputations or quadriplegia. Acting as a mouse interface, the system utilizes eye actions such as blinking, gestures, and gaze for interaction, with a focus on enhancing the computer interaction experience for users facing challenges in using their hands. Employing Python, OpenCV, NumPy, and other software packages for face recognition through a basic webcam, the system eliminates the need for additional sensors or gear. Additionally, it includes backend and frontend applications as part of the proposed Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) system, transforming eye movements into mouse cursor actions to offer a hands-free computing solution with potential benefits for accessibility.

articleTitle: Enhancing Website Through Chatbot Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: A chatbot is a computer software designed to converse with users in natural language. In the past, chatbots only used basic pattern matching to give the appearance of intelligence, the paper uses Dialogflow technology to create a chatbot. Chatbots actively assist the user by means of digital dialogue and natural language processing (NLP) powered by artificial intelligence (AI). The chatbot is pre-trained in NLP to comprehend user enquiries related to the website it is integrated with and provide a prompt response. The user provides textual or voice input related to the website. The paper correctly determines the user's needs and offers accurate responses to their questions in the course of the digital dialogue. The paper describes to create chatbot models that use machine learning powered by fast API to assist people in having accurate conversations. The user can ask questions at any time of day and the chatbot will provide accurate response. Chatbots can work 24/7 without getting tired hence increase productivity and minimize man power as well as errors. The principles of chatbot operation stem from two areas of artificial intelligence: natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning. NLP is beneficial in a variety of contexts, including online forums, digital marketing, and education.

articleTitle: Segmentation and Classification of Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) is a serious respiratory syndrome with incidence rates varying based on underlying factors like sepsis, covid and pneumonia. It can impact people of all ages, often necessitating mechanical ventilation. Mortality rates are more and influenced by factors like age, existing health conditions, and the triggering event's nature. Prompt intervention and addressing the root cause are pivotal. The manual segmentation of the lungs leads to workload for the workers. So our aim is to provide automatic lung segmentation with a high amount of accuracy and precision. Here the convolutional neural network was used to train the deep learning model using 257 sample affected images. Among these images 80% are used for training and the remaining 20% is used for testing the model. The trained deep learning model is evaluated using intersection over union (IOU). On the testing data set, the automatic segmentation gives the accuracy of 99% and the IOU index of 0.99. The trained model gave fast and precise results. The model can automatically segment the lungs with a high amount of precision.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Breast Cancer Subtyping: A Multi-Omic and Pan-Cancer Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Deep learning methods are increasingly used in biomedical research, including for cancer subtyping. This study explores deep learning-based breast cancer subtyping using pan-cancer and multi-omic data. It proposes a hybrid model combining Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) networks and XGBoost for temporal dependency and ensemble learning. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are also used to detect spatial patterns in multi-omic data. By combining these methods, the study aims to develop a more accurate breast cancer subtyping approach. The pan-cancer approach ensures the model's applicability across different cancer types. This research is expected to improve precision medicine and support more effective therapeutic strategies.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Prediction Using Deep Learning And Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Breast cancer is a major global health concern that is more common among women in the modern period. Many methods have been investigated for the diagnosis of breast cancer to address this problem, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and pre-trained models. Our study aims to enhance the efficacy and precision of breast cancer diagnosis by employing deep learning with transfer learning.

articleTitle: Intelligent Charging system for Electric Vehicle Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are becoming increasingly popular as a means of transportation due to their low environmental impact and energy efficiency. However, the limited driving range and long charging time of EV batteries remain major challenges. In this paper, we propose a smart charger for EV batteries that utilizes advanced algorithms to optimize the charging process. The proposed smart charger takes into account various factors such as battery chemistry, temperature, state of charge, and charging infrastructure capacity to determine the optimal charging rate. It is also able to communicate with the grid to adjust the charging rate and take advantage of renewable energy sources when available. Moreover, the charger is equipped with safety features such as overvoltage and over-current protection to ensure the safety of both the EV and the charging infrastructure. The design and implementation of the smart charger are presented in detail, including the hardware and software components. The results of experimental testing show that the proposed smart charger is able to reduce the charging time of EV batteries while maintaining their performance and safety. The proposed smart charger has the potential to accelerate the adoption of EVs by addressing one of the major barriers to their widespread use.

articleTitle: A Review on Advances in Computer Aided Weld Defects Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Welding is a commonly used industrial process. In this process two or more metal pieces or thermoplastics components are securely joined together by applying heat and pressure. Though the welding process depends on multiple factors, the type of material and material thickness is always the deciding factor to decide which method is most effective. Welding is proven to be an essential joining method, but defects in the welds can compromise the standard of the final product. Various types of weld defects that can occur, including porosity, inclusions, undercut, overlap, and lack of fusion, cracks, misalignment, distortion, spatter and burn-through. Welding defects are dangerous and may affect the quality and safety of welded products badly. Traditionally various methods have been introduced to detect welding defects, including visual inspection, ultrasonic inspection-ray inspection, and magnetic particle inspection. Machine learning has been increasingly applied to detect welding defects in recent years. This process automation reduces human involvement, thereby minimizing subjectivity and improving efficiency. Additionally, machine learning models can be continuously trained and updated to adapt to new defect patterns or welding techniques, enhancing their overall performance and generalizability.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition from Physiological Signals Using Ensembled Machine Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The field of emotion recognition by physiological signal analysis is the subject of the proposed study. Its primary objective is to evaluate how effectively various classifiers predict two important emotional variables: valence and arousal. Three distinct classifiers are used in the study: kELM (Kernel Extreme Learning Machine), nELM (Neural Extreme Learning Machine), and sSOM (Simplified Self-Organising Map) in order to give a comprehensive comparison analysis. The script contributes to the advancement of emotion perception by carefully contrasting the capabilities of multiple classifiers. By using the dataset, the research hopes to clarify the benefits and drawbacks of each classifier and contribute to the development of more dependable and precise emotion identification algorithms. The suggested study focuses on the area of physiological signal processing for emotion identification. Its main goal is to assess how well different classifiers perform in predicting valence and arousal, two crucial emotional variables.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics for Agricultural Futures: Modelling and Forecasting Net Exports of Commodities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Agricultural futures markets play a pivotal role in global trade, enabling producers, consumers, and investors to manage risks and capitalize on market opportunities. Accurate prediction of future exports is crucial for informed decision-making in this domain. In this research, we present a comparative analysis of several forecasting algorithms applied to “Agricultural Commodities Futures Data” sourced from Kaggle. The aim is to predict net exports for the next five years based on the selected commodity. We employ a range of models including Integrated Autoregressive Moving Average (ARIMA), Seasonal Autoregressive Integrate Moving-Average with Exogenous Regressors (SARIMAX), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO), Random Forest, and Local regression using LOESS combined with seasonal-trend decomposition. Through a Streamlit application, users can interactively input commodity names and receive forecasts generated by the various models.

articleTitle: Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) Algorithm for the Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Blood vessel recognition is crucial for many medical image analysis applications, such as diagnosis and screening for diabetic retinopathy. However, manual de-tection can take a while. To address this, re-searchers have developed a method that uti-lizes an Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) in a supervised manner to segment blood vessels in the retina. The process involves several stages, including pre-processing images, unsupervised and supervised learning, and post-processing techniques. During the pre-processing stage, various techniques such as image cropping, color modification, enhancement of contrast, Gabor processing, and rectification using half-waves are used to pre-process the images. The pre-processed images are utilized to create a feature vector and used for Principal Component Analysis (PCA). Pixels are separated into non-vessel and vessel clusters using clustering based on K-means on the PCA result. The ensemble classification process is then applied to the non-vessel region using root-guided decision trees with bagging. Finally, the outcomes of the ensemble classification and clustering methods are combined to produce the final segmentation image. Post-processing techniques, such as morphological approaches, are used to improve the vessel-segmented output. The proposed method is verified using publicly available photos from the DRIVE database and achieves an accuracy of 95.36% with higher sensitivity, indicating that more vessel pixels are detected effectively.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Earth station Transceiver employing subcarrier composite PCM/PSK/PM Modulation & Demodulation using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the design and implementation of an Earth station transceiver system that employs an innovative approach combining subcarrier composite Pulse Code Modulation (PCM), Phase Shift Keying (PSK), and Phase Modulation (PM) for modulation and demodulation processes. The study leverages MATLAB as the primary platform for simulation and analysis. The proposed system aims to enhance communication efficiency and reliability in satellite-based transmissions by integrating advanced modulation techniques. The study involves the development of comprehensive models for PCM, PSK, and PM modulation schemes, followed by their integration into a subcarrier composite framework. The MATLAB simulations assess the performance of the designed transceiver system under various conditions, such as channel impairments and noise, providing insights into its robustness and effectiveness. The satellite modulation scheme employs conversion of PCM bit stream data to NRZ-L encoding and applying BPSK modulation on NRZ-L data and later BPSK signal is Phase modulated to obtain PCM/PSK/PM sub carrier modulation. The demodulation scheme carried out on composite PCM/PSK/PM modulated signal. First it is PM demodulated and passed through FIR low pass filter to eliminate high frequency components to obtain PSK/PCM signal. The PSK/PCM signal then undergoes demodulation to get PCM (NRZ-L) signal and then PCM signal is then decoded to get original digital data transmitted. A proof-of-concept experiment has been realized on MATLAB. The simulation result validates the proposed architecture.

articleTitle: Human Machine Interface IoT Based System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: IoT has enabled mass to achieve massive connectivity and extreme interaction, not only in terms of the number of devices for communication but also in terms of real-time quality connections among them. Human-computer interface (HCI) is the key to having connections between users and machines. This paper presents HCI-based existing IoT systems available for various applications and also the tangible products based on HCI-based IoT systems. Various Algorithms used for various application based on human Computer interface (HCI) and IoT has been reviewed. In future, many advancements can be looked upon in the area of IoT and HCI by overcoming the limitations presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Differential Encoding Scheme for Low Variation Data Suitable for WSNs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: There are various digital encoding schemes like PCM, DPCM, Delta and Adaptive delta. All of these techniques reduce the redundancies in one way or the other. The proposed Differential Encoding scheme (DES) is an enhanced version of DPCM which overcomes the redundancy and gives a better compression ratio especially for low variation data. The proposed scheme is a very simple approach that is not so resource intensive and hence finds application with any constrained Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) or Ad-hoc network. Here we have chosen a sample size of fifty temperature readings on which the proposed DES scheme would be applied. The output of this scheme helps in reducing the size of data to be transmitted in any WSN based data routing or Ad-hoc network-based data routing applications. Similarly, the proposed differential encoding scheme can be used for optimizing the input data for other compression algorithms.

articleTitle: Optimized 5G Resource Allocation for Metaverse Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: With the proliferation of digitalization, there exists an ever-growing demand for network resources. The cutting-edge technology known as 5G is the epitome of this digitalization. The advent of the Metaverse, along with its diverse applications such as remote surgery and online gaming, further amplifies this demand. However, 5G alone cannot adequately meet these resource prerequisites. Consequently, an efficacious resource allocation algorithm becomes indispensable in order to effectively distribute these resources, thereby satisfying the needs of as many users as possible without compromising transmission quality. Leveraging the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) for this allocation process emerges as the most efficacious approach to tackling the resource crisis. Our proposed algorithm incorporates a priority function that classifies users into distinct ranks based on pivotal parameters, such as their position, available resources, and latency requirements, among others. Remarkably, we have achieved a substantial 15% reduction in resource requirements without compromising transmission quality, while maintaining the same number of users.

articleTitle: Conversion of STANAG RGsB Analog Video to 24-Bit RGB Video Format by Using Analog Video Decoder and FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Now a days innovations have become even more invasive; this work outlines a method for converting STANAG RGsB analog video to a 24-bit RGB video format utilizing an analog video decoder and a field-programmable gate array (FPGA). The STANAG RGsB (Red, sync-on-Green, Blue) is a common analog video format used in military applications, and the conversion to a digital RGB format enables compatibility with modern display systems. The proposed solution involves employing an analog video decoder to extract the RGsB video signal and synchronizing it with the FPGA-based video processing system. The analog video decoder converts the RGsB signal into digital video component. Once the digital video component is fed into the FPGA, it performs required processing tasks. The FPGA implementation includes functions such as colour space conversion, synchronization adjustment, resolution scaling, and necessary image enhancements or corrections. The FPGA's programmability allows for customization and optimization of the video processing algorithms to suit the specific requirements of the application. Furthermore, the FPGA can also incorporate additional functionalities such as overlaying graphical elements, text, or video analytics onto the converted RGB video stream. The proposed solution offers a flexible and scalable approach for converting STANAG RGsB analog video to a digital RGB format, leveraging the capabilities of both analog video decoders and FPGA-based video processing. This conversion enables seamless integration of legacy analog video sources into modern video systems, facilitating enhanced situational awareness and visual communication in military applications and beyond. The resulting digital video output provides improved compatibility with modern display systems, hence can be readily displayed on LCD/LED monitors, projectors, or other digital display devices without the need for specialized analog interfaces or converters.

articleTitle: Design and Development of 1:4 BALUN for HF band
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This paper presents the development of a 1 to 4 BALUN utilizing a ferrite core to convert a 50 ohm impedance at the coaxial cable end to a 200 ohm impedance at the considered antenna (LPDA) end, enabling enhanced efficiency in the lower HF band spanning from 3MHz to 15MHz. The primary focus lies in the design and construction of the BALUN to achieve superior common mode rejection (<-30dB) and minimal insertion loss (<0.3dB), while ensuring effective impedance transformation. Detailed discussions encompass core selection, construction methodologies, and measurement setups. Through meticulous design considerations and construction techniques, this research aims to contribute to the advancement of BALUN technology for optimized performance in HF frequency applications.

articleTitle: Temperature Prediction: A Comparative Comprehensive Study Between Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: In this study, we address the critical research area of temperature prediction, which holds significant implications for practical fields such as meteorology and agricultural studies. Our approach involves temperature forecasting, using three different machine learning algorithms: Multiple Linear Regression (MLR), Random Forest (RF) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN). We conduct a comparative study using sample experimental weather and temperature data collected from GitHub. The evaluation of experimental results is based on key metrics, including Mean Error (ME), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and Correlation Coefficients (CC). Through a thorough examination of these metrics, we find that MLR emerges as a better model for temperature prediction compared to both Artificial Neural Network and Random Forest. The results of our study contribute valuable insights into the effectiveness of these machine learning models in the context of temperature forecasting.

Author Keywords: minimum and maximum temperature forecasting and prediction

articleTitle: Novel Counter Design Utilizing QCA Based D Flip-Flops
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: In the evolving world of digital circuit design, Quantum-dot Cellular Automata (QCA) stands out as a game-changing approach that offers great improvements in size, power saving, and efficient use of space. This paper thoroughly investigates new QCA circuits, including a redesigned Divide by 2 Frequency Divider and the first Mod 2 Ring Counter ever made using QCA. Both circuits use QCA-based D Flip-Flops. The Divide by 2 Frequency Divider circuit has a cleaner, more efficient design, using 9 cells less than what was used before, showing a big improvement in design. At the same time, we designed a Mod 2 Ring Counter circuit using QCA technology, which is very compact with only 72 cells, making it a major step forward in this area. We looked at how these circuits perform, how stable they are when the temperature changes, and how little space they need, all of which highlight the overall advantages of QCA technology. An important part of our research compares the power used by our QCA designs to the power used by traditional CMOS designs. The QCA versions of the Divide by 2 Counter and Mod 2 Ring Counter use significantly less power, only 3.62e-22 Watts and 3.63e-22 Watts, which is much less compared to the CMOS versions' 0.085 Watts and 0.079 Watts. These results, confirmed using Verilog simulation and Xilinx Vivado tools, show that QCA is much better than CMOS technology when it comes to saving power. This research doesn't just introduce new QCA circuit designs but also creates a new standard for saving power in digital circuits.

articleTitle: Panoptic Region Slicing Segmentation and Optimized Alexnet-Based CNN for Early Melanoma Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The early and accurate diagnosis of melanoma, a potentially harmful skin cancer, is essential in enhancing the survival of patients. This paper describes a new method for detecting melanoma called Panoptic Region Slicing Segmentation (PRS2), which employs an AlexNet-based optimized convolution neural network (PRS2-OCNN). The proposed system integrates several advanced techniques to improve the efficiency and accuracy of melanoma detection. The first step is to preprocess the dermoscopic image with a 2D Fusion Filter to improve its quality and prepare it for further analysis. The Panoptic Region Slicing Segmentation (PRS2) method is then used to emphasize the boundary regions, allowing for more precise localization of melanoma-affected areas. We use Threshold Histogram Evaluation (THE) to assess color variations within segmented regions, which effectively characterizes melanoma-specific color patterns. The features were extracted using Spread Spectral Menzies' Feature Selection (SSMFS), which reduced dimensionality and increased the efficiency of the subsequent analysis. The optimized convolution neural network, derived from the influential AlexNet architecture, serves as the foundation of our proposed approach. By fine-tuning the AlexNet-OCNN on the reduced feature set, we can improve its ability to accurately classify melanoma lesions based on their risk level. The PRS2-OCNN categorizes melanoma classes based on their risk severity, allowing dermatologists to make informed decisions about timely and appropriate treatment. A broad and diversified dataset of dermoscopic images was used in the experimental evaluations. By thoroughly analyzing the melanoma-affected regions, the proposed system performed better than existing methods in terms of detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Object Tracking Robot Using SIFT Based Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Latterly, we have seen an immense increase in the amount of research, development and investment dedicated to the field of Autonomous Vehicle Technology or in common terms - Self-Driving Vehicles. While modern autonomous vehicles commonly use Machine and Deep Learning models using data from sensors to understand the environment and move autonomously, this project demonstrates the use of a digital image processing algorithm- SIFT, to enable a robot to track specific objects in an environment and follow them. The implementation of an efficient and innovative image tracking algorithm for autonomous vehicles is the most important outcome of this work. This paper mentions a few use cases of this work along with the potential and future scope of it.

articleTitle: Smart Clothing for Coal MineWorkers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The health and safety of miners are seriously at stake since coal mining is a difficult and dangerous job. Innovative solutions have been created to reduce these dangers and enhance the efficiency and safety of coalmining operations. One such solution is the coal mining jacket project, which integrates a number of crucial components, such as a temperature sensor, GPS, humidity sensor, pulse sensor, and gas sensor, to improve the safety and productivity of miners operating in challenging and hazardous conditions. A new device called “smart clothing” for coal mine workers combines wearable clothes with sensors, microcontrollers, and communication modules to improve worker safety, health monitoring, and overall operating efficiency. This essay provides a thorough analysis of the literature on smart clothing for coalmine employees, highlighting its uses, benefits, and potential future applications. Real-time monitoring and detection of dangerous situations inside the coal mine, such as harmful gas leaks, excessive heat, or high humidity levels, are made possible by the use of sensors such as gas sensors, temperature and humidity sensors, and environmental sensors. Early detection enables prompt intervention and the use of proper safety precautions to safeguard personnel.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Prediction and Hierarchical Classification of Heart Disease Severity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Heart disease poses a significant threat to human existence because of its high mortality and morbidity rates. For early treatment, localization, and countermeasure, precise anticipation and conclusion are becoming increasingly important. The Internet of Things and artificial intelligence make it easier for doctors to find, evaluate, and diagnose cardiac diseases. However, the majority of prediction models only assess the severity of an individual's illness and only predict whether they are ill or not. In this study, we present a hypothesis model for simultaneous assumption for both matched and distinct request coronary illness that is based on machine learning (ML). We first developed a fuzzy-GBDT strategy that combines cushy reasoning with gradient boosting decision tree (GBDT) to advance the matched portrayal assumption and reduce data complexity. To avoid overfitting, the pressing is completed with GBDT. The severity of cardiac disease is also included in the multi classification assumption based on Bagging-Fuzzy-GBDT. The assessment shows that the Packing Fluffy GBDT is incredibly dependable and exact for both twofold and different get-together presumptions.

articleTitle: Solar Array Bus Voltage Regulator for Small Satellite Using FS3R (Fixed Switching String Shunt Regulator) Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a solar array bus voltage regulator for small spacecraft applications by introducing a novel technique using Fixed Switching String Shunt Regulator (FS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>R). The primary objective is to enhance the performance of established Hysteresis (L TP & UTP) control Shunt Regulator and Sequential Switching Shunt Regulator (S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>R) by employing an innovative hysteresis level implementation method. The proposed method involves the management of the solar array output power through dynamic ranges of coarse control and a single fine control, with intent to enhance efficiency and reliability of spacecraft power system. In addition, it provides better results than other methods in terms of Electromagnetic Interference (EMI), noise coupling, bus ripple voltage and ease of building control loops. Simulation results and experimental findings are demonstrated here to validate the effectiveness and practical approach of FS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>R technique. [11]–[17].

articleTitle: Quantification of the Effects of Circuit Parameters on the Design of Full-Bridge Phase-Shift Controlled Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Full-Bridge phase-shift controlled DC-DC converters are widely used for high power and high voltage applications due to favorable switching conditions for the active switches. This paper discusses various practical issues that must be considered and their impact on the converter's performance (such as ZVS range, losses, and peak current). The paper also derives systematic and normalized design-oriented expressions that quantify the effects of circuit parameters on the converter's performance. These expressions can be scaled to any power level to meet specific design requirements.

articleTitle: Human Object Interactivity Detection usingGraph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Graph-based machine learning is a versatile framework tailored for diverse object interactions, particularly in action recognition. Skeleton-based Graph Neural Network (GNN) methods have proven effective, capturing temporal relationships in frame-by-frame human- object interactions. This study addresses the complexity of recognizing multiple actions in untrimmed videos, focusing on a multi-person scenario. YOLOv5's object detection identifies objects in videos, and various neural network architectures (ANN, 1DCNN, LSTM, GNN) are compared for action recognition. The GNN-based technique, leveraging adult skeleton data from established datasets, outperforms others in efficiency and accuracy, showcasing its potential for robust human-object interaction recognition.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of CNN and SVM Models for Facial Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The proposed study investigates the application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Support Vector Machines (SVM) in the recognition and classification of five basic human emotions: happiness, sadness, anger, fear, and surprise. Affective computing with emotion recognition “a great element of it “looks forward to better human-machine interfaces that get machines to understand and echo human emotions via reading and responding to the emotional states of people. By retrieving the data from the vast array of facial expressions, the data was preprocessed to be able to meet the model's expectations. After that CNN and SVM models were designed and trained with the dataset of these some performance evaluation criteria i.e. accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score were taken into account. The CNN model generated higher performance in the overall evaluation, particularly as indicated by accuracy and F1 score. This was mainly attributed to its optimally visual data feature extraction capability. The SVM model has also revealed a good performance, however, mainly in precision accuracy which represents its success in classification tasks. The undertaking is part of the new emerging field of affective computing, which provides comparative insights into the capabilities of CNN and SVM models in facial emotion recognition and thus a possible use of the strength of both in hybrid models. The remaining issues to be addressed are regarding the fusion models and the sensory data integration to achieve higher accuracies and reliabilities of emotion recognition.

articleTitle: Soft Computing Based Hybrid MPPT for Grid Connected Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This study proposes a grid-connected photovoltaic (PV) system consisting of a direct current (DC) - direct current (DC) boost converter and voltage source inverter (VSI). Different maximum power extraction techniques was used to obtain the greatest possible power produced by a solar photovoltaic (PV) system. The perturb and observe (P&O), BAT and a novel hybrid combination of BAT-PO chosen as the power tracking technique. The output voltage of the boost converter was regulated and synchronized with a 100 kW PV system to the grid. To increase the PV system's performance, a suitable duty ratio required for the boost converter was tuned effectively by implementing a novel hybrid MPPT technique, that is, BAT-PO algorithm. In addition, the current control technique is implemented in a voltage source inverter to minimize the grid current's harmonics. Maximum power, efficiency, and THD are the indicators used to assess the performance of MPPT algorithms. The proposed system was implemented and tested in MATLAB/Simulink using various MPPT techniques. Among the chosen MPPT algorithms, In terms of maximum power (93.9kW) and THD (0.32%), the BAT-PO hybrid MPPT algorithm performed significantly better than the competition. The major goals of this study are to maximize power and minimize THD.

articleTitle: Dual Mode SIMO Biquad Filter Using VDTA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This paper introduces a biquadratic filter configuration that operates in dual mode with a single input and multiple outputs (SIMO) providing two voltage mode functions (low-pass and band-pass), three transadmittance mode functions (low-pass, high-pass and band-pass) and three current mode functions (low-pass, high-pass and band-pass) based on VDTA.
