The proposed configuration, utilizing two Voltage Differencing Transconductance Amplifiers (VDTAs) and two grounded capacitors, is designed without the need for external resistors. This makes it well-suited for potential integration into a single integrated circuit (IC). It provides adaptability through the option to configure into voltage mode, current mode, or transadmittance mode structures, based on the selected input excitation. The proposed structure allows independent tuning of the angular frequency (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$w_{o}$</tex>) without affecting the bandwidth. The feasibility of the suggested biquadratic configuration is illustrated through PSPICE simulations employing the 0.18µm TSMC CMOS process specifications.

articleTitle: Automated Glaucoma Detection and Classification via Deep Neural Networks and Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Glaucoma, a progressive visual neuropathy, is a leading cause of lifelong blindness worldwide. Early identification and accurate classification are crucial for rapid treatment of glaucoma and preservation of vision. The research suggests a new approach to identify and detect glaucoma by integrating deep neural networks with advanced feature extraction methods. The proposed method involves selecting relevant features from retinal images to detect subtle patterns indicating signs of glaucomatous changes. A deep neural network architecture is then utilized to process these characteristics for accurate and automated classification. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy in obtaining high accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity in detecting and classifying glaucoma is supported by experimental results on a large dataset. Deep neural networks and feature extraction synergize effectively as a promising approach to enhance automated glaucoma detection systems.

articleTitle: A Review of Multi-Band Flexible MIMO Antenna Design on Thin Substrate for High Diversity Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This review article explores a range of design techniques employed in multi-band flexible MIMO antennas on thin substrate to enhance isolation, gain, efficiency, compactness, ECC, DG and channel capacity. It delves into research on various design types and their associated performance enhancement methods. The paper aims to compare different antenna designs based on their respective performance enhancement techniques, offering insights into the advancements and strategies utilized in optimizing flexible MIMO antenna performance.

articleTitle: “Photovoltaic Hotspot Detection and Monitoring System”
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This paper introduces an IoT-based Photovoltaic Hotspot Detection and Monitoring System designed to optimize the performance and reliability of solar energy systems. Utilizing a 1.3W, 7.5V solar panel, INA219, DHT22, DS3231 RTC module, and ESP32 for real-time monitoring, and an Arduino Nano, AMG8833 thermal sensor, and TFT display for hotspot detection, the system seamlessly integrates with a 000webhost dashboard. The monitoring component collects real-time data on environmental parameters and energy production metrics, which is efficiently stored in a MySQL database and visualized on the 000webhost dashboard. The absence of a relay or load management system simplifies the design, focusing on monitoring and hotspot detection. The holistic approach presented in this paper contributes to the advancement of sustainable and optimized solar energy utilization, with potential applications in both residential and commercial photovoltaic installations.

articleTitle: Interim Analysis Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to recalculate sample size by adjusting the initial design about trial results and taking uncertainty in power estimations into consideration throughout study preparation. This article examines two primary methods: Pocock and O'Brien/Fleming using R programming. Interim data analysis must be done far in advance to provide enough power and minimize the risk of having Type I errors. These results suggest that robust performance indicators have enabled improved comprehension of the study's development, notably increased control, more efficient use of resources (e.g., monitoring time), quicker enrolment, shorter operational timelines, and less expensive costs.

articleTitle: Design of Grid Connected EV Charging Station Incorporated with Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The innovative concept known as the Universal Electric Vehicle (EV) Charger with Adaptive Buck Converter aims to transform the infrastructure around EV charging. With the help of a clever buck converter included into the system, any electric vehicle's battery rating can be instantly detected and adjusted, guaranteeing safe and effective charging. This approach makes charging easier and more accessible for electric vehicle (EV) customers globally by doing away with the requirement for several chargers with different voltage outputs. For all EV models, the charger offers rapid and dependable charging by sensibly identifying the battery characteristics of the EV and optimizing the voltage output appropriately.

articleTitle: Empowering Forestry Conservation with AI: Severity Classification of Sequoia Canker Using Siamese CNNs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The rise of plant diseases recognized to be a great menace to global biodiversity and forestry must call for modern methods of diagnostic and classification tools. Within the list of these diseases, the most notable one is the Sequoia cypress canker, which is a pathogenic infection caused by the organism Seiridium company and its impacts on the health and lifespan of Sequoia cypress trees are very important for both ecological balance and the industries connected with this tree as a raw material. Conventional approaches that involve disease detection and classification of severity levels can be both tedious and inaccurate due to human errors, i.e. subjective decisions. This research will make use of one of the innovative applications of the Siamese Convolutional Neural Networks (Siamese CNNs) which is the classification system of varying the levels of severity in the Sequoia Canker a disease in the cypress trees, that uses the network in recognizing fine differences in the manifestations of the disease. The dataset preparation stems from heterogenic sources, the design of a Siamese CNN which adapts to the assignment, and an extensive training and evaluation process as well. The model proved to be a better predictor of the disease severity, discriminating the subject into five levels of disease which have an accuracy of 92.9%, outperforming both the traditional CNN models and manual classification methods in metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and f1 score. The findings reveal that Siamese CNN is an outstanding tool to transform the way we classify plant disease severities, providing us with scalable and effective work that does not get influenced by the experts' personal bias. Firstly, the conducted research is an addition to the expanding collection of literature at the junction between artificial intelligence and environmental science, though it can be learned that appropriate tools can solve key issues of plant pathology and forestry management. The successful application of CNN for disease severity distinction suggests further use of these AI tools for addressing environmental problems. Thus, one of the possible pathways to sustainable management and the conservation of natural resources is the possibility of introducing Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven solutions.

articleTitle: Development and Prototype Testing of Vehicle Speed Control with Real-Time Operating System Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The proposed work seeks to develop an innovative vehicle speed regulation system that adapts in real-time to local population density and road conditions, utilizing the RTX Kernel within a Real-Time Operating System (RTOS). Conventional speed limit solutions often struggle to adjust to changing traffic dynamics and environmental factors. The pro-posed system employs sensor and communication technologies to continuously monitor population density and road conditions, ensuring a dynamic response. With the RTOS at its core, reliable and efficient data processing is guaranteed, enabling swift reactions and informed decision-making. Notably, the system incorporates an adjustable speed restriction algorithm that takes into consideration real-time variables such as traffic patterns and population density. Supported by ARM Cortex-M3 project boards (LPC1768), kernel objects like Tasks and Event Flags play vital roles in system implementation. To enhance efficiency and performance, the project employs optimization techniques such as dead code elimination and code minimization.

articleTitle: Classification of Lung Sound Signals using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Although the easiest pre-screening approach for lung disease diagnosis is using a stethoscope to analyse the lung sounds, it is not employed as a conclusive diagnostic test because it is greatly dependent on the physician's competence and expertise. This research presents a machine learning-based autonomous lung disease detection system in the hope of making lung sound diagnosis more conclusive. After signal decomposition with Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), the Ensemble Rus-Boost classifier is employed in this method to classify lung sounds. Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) vs non-COPD, COPD vs healthy, COPD vs URTI and COPD vs Pneuomonia are the four binary classifiers analysed in this paper.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis and Collision Risk Assessment of Near-Earth Orbit Space Debris for Sustainable Space Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This study employs a rigorous data-driven approach to quantitatively assess the risks associated with N ear-Earth Objects (NEOs). Focusing on NEOs with diameters exceeding 100 meters and those approaching within one Lunar Distance from Earth, we analyze 23 years of data from the Centre for Near-Earth Object Studies (CNEO). Our analysis reveals significant gaps in our ability to monitor these celestial bodies, with approximately one-third of potentially hazardous NEOs remaining undetected. The study underscores the importance of enhanced efforts in NEO detection, tracking, and planetary defense strategies to mitigate the low but tangible probability of NEO collisions with Earth's orbit. Following an initial collision, the likelihood of a subsequent impact increases by 2.6 percent and 2.3 percent, respectively. Addressing these challenges is crucial for safeguarding life on Earth against the potential threats posed by these cosmic phenomena.

articleTitle: Proposing Forensic Watermarking Techniques for Detecting Movie Piracy Through Camcorders
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Movie piracy proliferates through numerous means, where camcorders and video cameras play a predominant role. Our area of specialization lies in understanding and examining the environment of theatres, human reaction time, filmmaker's requirements and proposing robust forensic watermarking techniques that can be employed to battle such movie piracy attacks, which takes place through camcorder reproduction. We analyzed the resilience and retentivity of watermarking after compression, modification and distortion attacks. Considering an ideal theatrical scenario, we have also taken into account the noise and interference that could be present in the sound and light channels of a reproduced video. The methods of analysis and research are majorly seated and orbit along the fields of Computer Vision, Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Statistical Analysis. The goal is to embed a sturdy enough watermark which can survive a camcorder reproduction and have as minimal information loss as possible.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of AMBA AXI Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Amidst the modern technological landscape, microelectronics has assumed unparalleled significance in individuals' daily lives. The heightened demand for these components, coupled with their limited availability, imposes constraints on production timelines and elevates final product failure rates. Consequently, there is a critical need for methodologies that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of hardware design and verification, where the latter has become a predominant cost in the overall design process. Addressing this challenge, the Advanced Microcontroller Bus Architecture (AMBA) emerges as an open-standard on-chip interface interconnect. Its standardized signal bus architecture facilitates the seamless interconnection of various modules within a system, giving rise to the system-on-a-chip (SoC) design methodology. Despite the challenges associated with verifying on-chip bus protocols, this project successfully designs the AXI protocol using Verilog HDL, establishing a robust verification methodology with System Verilog (SV). The verification process attains success in validating the AMBAAXI Protocol, specifically in Write and Read Operations, incorporating an incremental burst feature. This achievement is supported by a scalable test bench architecture, defining a standard set of rules for effective communication within the System on Chip (SoC), ensuring the reliability and efficiency of microelectronic systems.

articleTitle: Battery Charging Current Impact on Operational Expenditure for Hybrid Telecom Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Remote telecom stations incorporating renewable resources such as Photovoltaic(PV) assets, along with Lithium-ion Battery Energy Storage Systems(BESS) and Diesel Generator(DG) need to evaluate the operating expenditure over time. Majority of research based on such hybrid infrastructure sites focus on the optimal sizing of PV, BESS, and DG for reliable power output. A major factor often overlooked is that though Li-ion batteries are the primary choice for BESS systems due to high power density, and longer lifetimes, they are subject to capacity degradation due to the operating conditions, resulting in a reduction in the lifetime and increase in battery replacements. This reduced capacity increases the fuel consumption for the load profile. Transportation costs and fuel losses, due to leaks and theft, also play a part in evaluation of the Operational Expenditure(OPEX). In this paper, we have sought to evaluate the impact of all these factors on the OPEX of an off-grid system.

articleTitle: Verilog-A Based 8-Bit Pipeline ADC Tailored for Low Power Performance and High-Speed Operation in 90 nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This research delves into the intricate realm of designing and fine-tuning of an 8-bit pipeline Analog-to-Digital-Converter (ADC), navigating the delicate balance between power efficiency and speed optimization. The chosen pipeline ADC architecture offers a promising avenue for achieving superior resolution while managing power consumption effectively. Through innovative strategies tailored to mitigate power drain and speed constraints inherent in conventional pipeline ADCs, this study pioneers a novel approach. Grasping the simplicity of a one-bit stage in the pipeline ADC, the design harnesses the cascading structure of multiple stages, facilitating seamless implementation using high-level transistor languages like Verilog-A. The paper presents the meticulous design process of an 8-bit Pipelined Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC) fabricated with 90 nm CMOS technology, meticulously characterizing its performance metrics such as SNR, SFDR, power dissipation, and consumption. Notably, simulation results showcase an impressive power dissipation of 2.8 mW, alongside a measured SNR of 56.35 dB, SFDR of 66.39 dB, and a power consumption of 0.12W, all achieved within the confines of 90 nm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation and Optimization of Adder Performance with Hybrid FinFET-GDI Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This study proposes a novel approach that combines a hybrid FinFET-Gate Diffusion Input (GDI) logic to create a Carry Select Adder (CSLA) architecture on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs). Carry Select Adders are crucial parts of digital signal processing and frequently demand for excellent performance. But Carry Select Adder's traditional FPGA implementation often uses a lot of power, which makes it impractical to use them in situations when power is limited. In order to address this issue, we provide a design approach that leverages the benefits of FinFET-GDI and CSLA logic. The CSLA architecture provides fast operation, while the FinFET-GDI logic reduces power consumption by making effective use of transistors. We are able to develop a low-power Carry Select Adder that is appropriate for FPGA systems by combining these strategies. Tanner synthesis and implementation demonstrate the effectiveness of the suggested design, demonstrating significant power savings while maintaining critical performance metrics such as time and delay. In conclusion, the SPARTAN 3E Kit was used to construct the hardware for the suggested low-power Carry Select Adder. The Tanner tool was used to conduct simulations, which made it possible to thoroughly analyze and validate the design. Moreover, Xilinx software was utilized to extract netlists and thoroughly verify them, guaranteeing the accuracy and stability of the implementation. The Power consumption in adders is reduced by 17%, our technique shows promise for low-power embedded signal processing applications, since experimental results show significant power reductions over previous approaches.

articleTitle: ECG - Driven Heart Disorder Profiler using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Right now, heart illness is the driving cause of passing around the world and its frequency is on the rise. To precisely analyze heart illness in its early stages some time recently a heart event occurs, it is troublesome to do so. There is a large amount of data on heart disease available in the healthcare sector such as clinics, hospitals, etc., but it is not easy to process this data to identify hidden patterns. Machine learning techniques can help to transform this medical data into valuable information. Machine learning can be used to design support system that can learn from their experiences. The aim of the research is to furnish the heart illness diagnosis in the most precise way. The proposed work uses machine learning and feature selection algorithms to compute results using the hybrid model. Methods like the Random Forest, Boruta, decision tree, logistic regression (LR), support vector machine (SVM), logistic regression with SVM, and hybrid models that combine logistic regression with SVM and Random Forest were used in this process. The assessment includes both individual and ensemble models and covers all heart disease datasets. Hybrid models are evaluated across multiple datasets using key metrics such as true positive rate, specificity, accuracy. The proposed framework's results are analyzed with following extensive experimentation. The study found that the proposed hybrid machine learning models outperform individual models and approaches in terms of accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity across all heart disease datasets.

articleTitle: Integrated Rasnet Model for Efficient Automated Assessment and Sorting of Leaf Diseases in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: A novel integrated methodology for the automated assessment and sorting of leaf diseases in agricultural settings is provided in this work. The method improves the efficiency and accuracy of disease evaluation by combining deep learning and machine learning methodologies. Pre-processing techniques like contrast enhancement and color space conversion are the first steps in the research process since they set the conditions for further investigation. K-Means clustering is used to divide the image into regions, enabling user input for the purpose of selecting the disease region. In this work we proposed RASNet model (Recurrent and SVM Hybrid Network for Enhanced Leaf Disease Classification). A more complete texture analysis is made possible by highlighting the significance of picture preprocessing. The purpose of introducing a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) strategically is to extract temporal dependencies and sequential patterns from picture data. Combined with carefully collected texture data, these RNN outputs help classify diseases using a Multiclass Support Vector. We have used images of leaves affected by different bacterial and fungal diseases: Alternaria Alternata, Anthracnose, Bacterial Blight and Cercospora Leaf Spot in our experiment and our proposed method.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Predict Flight Fares in India Using SOM-LSSVM Model Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Travel ticket prices can rise or fall on a regular basis depending on factors including travel schedule, destination, and duration. A prediction model will be generated in the proposed system by using machine learning techniques to the collected flight history data. Since there isn't enough information for anyone to make informed predictions regarding the future of airline ticket pricing, customers don't always know when to buy their tickets. When it comes to data preprocessing, feature selection, and training models, sequence is key. We cleaned the data and converted it from string to date time objects as part of the preprocessing; after that, we retrieved numerical values from the altered times, dates, and locations of departure and arrival. An essential part of this study was the use of EHO to optimize and select features. Feature selection plays a vital role in SOM-LSSVM model training. In every test, the proposed method beats the state-of-the-art algorithms, including SOM and LSSVM. The results clearly showed a tremendous improvement with an accuracy percentage of 97.41%.

articleTitle: An Energy Efficient IoT Based Smart Street Lighting Using Low Cost SOC
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) has radically improved and modernized in every aspect of human existence. The term IoT is a recent trend that states the development a self-configurable network by connecting a variety of hardware objects, to internet without requiring human input to improve service delivery and automate processes by means of data transmission to the cloud. Streetlights are an essential component of any city, although they provide safer roadways, improved night vision, and increased visibility of public spaces it uses a significant amount of electricity and operates at maximum intensity from dusk till dawn. The wastage of electricity can be secured by having lights turn OFF on their own if it is not in use. This work presents an energy efficient IoT-based smart street lighting by using low-cost System On Chip (SOC) circuit. This work deploys an LDR sensor which acts as a decision device, to choose whether to switch ON or OFF the street light based on the level of ambient light. This simple switch has a relay at its output and is activated by either light or dark. This switching may be done using a cost-effective Wi-Fi module namely, ESP8266 for which the LDR sensed value is given as input. Any user can check the status of a street light whether it is ON/OFF from anywhere using internet in real time. It promises great dependability and remarkable stability for long-term. The proposed work is implemented using a NodeMCU board that is designed to supply the required light intensity at different times.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Predicting the Risk of Illegal Activity and Evaluating Law Enforcement Using WideDeep SGRU Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The main reaction to the illicit extraction of natural resources in protected areas around the world is law enforcement patrols headed by rangers. On the other hand, research on patrols' efficacy in reducing criminal behavior is lacking. Similarly, tactics to enhance the effectiveness of patrol organization and monitoring have received very little attention. Sequencing is crucial for model training, feature selection, and preprocessing. Preprocessing steps include cleaning, discretizing, duplicating, and normalizing data. Feature selection makes use of genetic algorithms, which are basically search algorithms with an evolutionary bent that factor in natural selection and genetics. Training stacked GRU models necessitates meticulous feature management. Even the most cutting-edge algorithms, GRU and BiGRU, are no match for the suggested technique. An astounding 97.24% accuracy grade was disclosed by the results, showcasing exceptional growth.

articleTitle: E-ATM For Card Less Transactions Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: A fingerprint recognition technique in the ATM system is the foundation of this study. We chose this to improve client security and facilitate simple transactions. Since every person has unique fingerprint details, this method will be more widely applicable. It is not necessary to keep your ATM card on hand at all times, nor is there any concern that your card will be lost. It is shown that fingerprint recognition technology outperforms and is safer than other technologies when compared to other ATM security systems already in use. This facilitates safe and simple transactions while maintaining a user-friendly environment. Without a doubt, service providers should also consider security when designing their ATM products, in order to protect financial transactions against security threats. And a lot about security holes, identity theft, credit card fraud, and ways for hackers and criminals to get any sensible passwords or pin numbers. Similar to a username, identification is employed in the present architecture to provide access to the system. To ensure that the intended user is indeed who say they are, since passwords may be stolen or lost. Biometric identity and authentication technologies are the most modern answers to security and privacy problems. The study of traits that may be used to identify a person is known as face recognition. These bodily attributes include, among other things, faces, voices, fingerprints, and hand shapes. The different security system authentication techniques are surveyed in this paper. This face biometric with QR code verification offers the highest degree of security in authentication. One of the most promising technologies for electronic money transactions is this procedure. The need for quick and precise user identification and authentication has increased due to the expansion of the electronic transaction industry. The Automated Teller Machine (ATM) is a fantastic convenience for people to satisfy their financial requirements. Notwithstanding the many benefits of this system, ATM fraud has lately grown in severity. This technique aids in reducing ATM theft and improper usage by other parties. We suggested the approach to stop anyone from damaging or ruining the devices, stopping fraudulent users or masks from denying transactions to ATM customers and other users.

articleTitle: Improving WDM in SMF-PON with Polarization Multiplexing and Optical Comb
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The social media platforms have become more data-intensive with the proliferation of high-resolution images, videos, and live streaming. To meet these growing bandwidth demands, telecommunication companies and internet service providers are continually upgrading their networks, deploying fiber-optic connections, and developing faster and more efficient technologies, 5G for wireless communication. Passive Optical Networks are indeed well considered an attractive and efficient solution for delivering high-speed internet and other communication services to end-users. The combination of cost efficiency, energy efficiency, flexibility, scalability, and other advantages makes PONs an appealing choice for telecommunications providers looking to deliver high-speed broadband and other services to a wide range of customers. They operate particularly well with deployments of FTTH and FTTB, which are next-generation broadband access networks. The paper is a systematic study and analysis approach in optimizing the system for both high data rates and enhanced capacity, considering different modulation techniques such as MDRZ, CSRZ, NRZ, RZ.

articleTitle: Early Detection and Accurate Prediction of Heart Disease: The Role of Stacked GRU-TCN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: cardiovascular diseases represent a significant global health challenge, with the incidence of cardiac conditions rising steadily due to lifestyle factors such as poor diet and lack of exercise. Detecting and monitoring cardiovascular disease within large datasets is critical for effective public health management. This study presents a systematic approach for the efficient detection of cardiovascular disease, encompassing data preprocessing, feature selection, and model training. Sequential processing is essential for each stage of the methodology. Data preprocessing involves outlier removal and data standardization to ensure data quality and consistency. Feature selection techniques are employed to identify the most influential variables for model training. Careful consideration is given to feature selection during the training of a Stacked GRU-TCN model to optimize model performance. Comparative analysis demonstrates the superior performance of the proposed approach over TCN and GRU algorithms, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 96.70%. These findings underscore the potential of advanced modeling techniques in enhancing cardiovascular disease detection and management.

articleTitle: Content Poisoning Attacks in Named Data Networks: Detection and Mitigation Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: With the increase in content-based communication in applications such as the web, multimedia streaming, social media, Internet of things etc., the content-based communication paradigm, ICN in general and NDN architecture in particular, is becoming popular. Although NDN has proved to be a potential replacement for IP host-based Internet, inherent security threats such as Content Poisoning Attacks (CPAs) pose a severe threat to communication. To tackle the issue, the research community has been discussing detection and mitigation methods of various scales. This paper is an attempt to bring out the state-of-the-art methods in CPA detection and mitigation and the analysis of the same concerning its overhead, latency, resiliency to malicious entities etc. The approach discussed in this work provides a better insight into the robust requirements of CPA detection and mitigation methods in the future.

articleTitle: Demand Planning and Forecasting in the High Technology Industry Based on Hybrid CEEMDAN-GA-BPNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Since it enables decision-makers to foresee the circumstances and scenarios surrounding a subject before acting, forecasting is essential in planning and decision-making across all fields. In order to provide precise predicted values, numerous forecasting methods have been created. Consumer price indices are useful for many things, but one of the most important is keeping everyone up-to-date on price changes that impact the Yemeni economy as a whole. Following a logical progression, we cover preprocessing, feature extraction, and training the model. Conventional methods of data preparation, such wavelet and Fourier transform technology, have a few drawbacks. Feature extraction makes use of PSO, a popular bio-inspired approach to optimization problems involving continuous and discontinuous functions. A CEEMDAN-GA-BPNN approach was used to train this model. This method appears antiquated when contrasted with GA and CEEMDAN. There is little doubt that the data demonstrates an improvement, with an impressive accuracy percentage of 96.55%.

Author Keywords: Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition With Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN)

articleTitle: A survey on Machine Learning Methods used for Classification of Cardiovascular disease using ECG and Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This research explores critical research gaps in cardiovascular disease detection and prediction, emphasizing the urgent need for further investigation. The identified gaps encompass interpretability issues in machine learning models, insufficient comparisons between contemporary and traditional diagnostic methods, and a lack of attention to generalization performance across diverse patient populations. The review underscores the importance of addressing gaps in model interpretability, real-world challenges of Convolutional Neural Network algorithms, and the exploration of optimal feature sets for predictive modelling. Recognizing limitations such as small datasets and the opaque nature of certain models, the imperative for future studies to prioritize explainable AI frameworks and address broader challenges in data overfitting, cost-effectiveness, and model bias is emphasized. The research advocates for the exploration of alternative algorithms to enhance accuracy and interpretability in cardiovascular disease detection and prediction.

articleTitle: Beamforming Networks for 5G. A Literature Review of Butler Matrix
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: As we are evolving into higher generations of mobile communications for improving our quality of services like low latency, achieving higher data rates, managing exponential increases in number of users and others, we are in need to improve our hardware design of devices (mobile handset and base stations). In this paper, we are going to discuss the changes to be done in the devices to improve the data rates with the help of beamforming techniques that could be implemented through Butler matrix method. Beamforming plays a key role in the fifth generation (5G) and beyond fifth generation (B5G) mobile communication. This paper is organized in a way that, firstly, it discusses the need for beamforming followed by broad divisions of beamforming techniques. Secondly, it focuses on analog beamforming methods like the Blass matrix, Nolen matrix and discusses Butler Matrix in detail. A summary of this work and the expectations for improving the network for future applications are provided in the conclusion. The second part of the paper discusses the different literatures that implement Butler Matrix (BM) as a feed network for Beamforming applications. Various methods to improve the circuit like miniaturizing the circuit, improving the bandwidth of operation, reducing the loss in the circuit, increasing the number of beams produced by the BM, dual band operation, polarization reconfigurability, improving gain and reducing Side Lobe Levels (SLL), etc. are discussed. These improvisations are done by making changes in conventional BM, by eliminating some components, using Metamaterials(MTM) to design components, using multi-layer substrates, designing a special array of antennas, using waveguide technology like Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW), using Electronic Band Gap(EBG) method, Defected Ground Surface(DGS) and others methods are discussed.

articleTitle: Enhancing Wellness and Location Monitoring for Mountain Climbers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Reducing the dangers associated with high-altitude activities requires improving mountain climbers' safety and tracking skills. In this work, an inventive Internet of Things (IoT)-based system is presented to overcome the difficulties of accurate position tracking and real-time health monitoring in hilly terrain. An Arduino microcontroller is integrated with temperature and pulse sensors to enable the gadget to continually monitor climbers' vital signs and communicate data over IoT networks. Metrics including reaction speed, accuracy of position tracking, and dependability of health monitoring are used to assess system performance. By providing climbers with up-to-date information on their health and location, the proposed system seeks to improve response times and increase climbers' safety in challenging and remote locations.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of NFC and Bluetooth for File Transfer Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This study investigates the trade-offs between near field communication (NFC) and Bluetooth technologies for file transfer. We delve into critical factors like data transfer speed, power consumption, and user satisfaction to determine which technology reigns supreme in different contexts. Our findings suggest that NFC's strength lies in secure and swift device pairing, making it ideal for small file transfers. However, for larger files, its limitations in speed and efficiency become apparent. Bluetooth, while reliable for remote transfers, falls short in terms of security and quick pairing. Notably, users favor NFC's user-friendly experience, highlighting its potential for specific use cases. This study acknowledges its limitations and opens doors for future research exploring hybrid approaches or individual technology advancements to optimize file transfer experiences for diverse needs.

articleTitle: Design and FPGA Implementation of Satellite Telemetry Transmitter Employing PCM/PSK/PM Sub-Carrier Modulation Using DDS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: In Satellite communication measurement and control system, the most predominant radio telemetry and remote-control modulation system is PCM/PSK/PM. Satellites utilizes PCM/PSK/PM sub-carrier modulation to communicate with Ground station to transmit Telemetry (health) data of satellite. Major space agencies like NASA, ESA & ISRO have employed subcarriers for both tele-command and telemetry data transmissions. Use of sub-carriers allows separating different types of data as well as ensuring no overlap between the modulated data's frequency spectra and the RF carrier. This paper presents the design and FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) implementation of Satellite Transmitter employing PCM (Pulse Code Modulation), PSK (Phase Shift Keying), and PM (Phase Modulation) in a subcarrier modulation scheme. The transmitter leverages Direct Digital Synthesizer (DDS) as a key component to achieve precise signal generation. The integration of PCM, PSK, and PM in subcarrier modulation offers advantages in terms of spectral efficiency and signal quality. Algorithm using DDS ip is simulated in Vivado on ZynQ Ultrascale-ZCU111 FPGA board. The FPGA implementation enhances the flexibility and adaptability of the system, making it suitable for a wide range of satellite communication applications. The proposed transmitter architecture is thoroughly analyzed, and its performance is evaluated through simulations and practical experiments, demonstrating its feasibility and effectiveness in satellite communication systems.

articleTitle: Strengthening Cloud Security Through Multi-Factor Authentication: A Comprehensive Integration of Diverse Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Strong security measures are crucial as businesses increasingly rely on cloud computing. This study explores the integration of Multifactor Authentication (MFA) to enhance cloud security. By requiring users to undergo various forms of identity verification before accessing cloud resources, MFA adds a redundant layer of security. The study delves into the benefits and specialized aspects of MFA within cloud security, considering authentication factors like biometrics, tokens, and passwords. Additionally, it addresses Zero Trust, following the principle of ‘never trust, always verify, ‘ensuring confidence is never assumed, regardless of a trusted network. It details the necessary architecture and programs for implementation within a cloud environment. The study emphasizes practical benefits, including improved threat mitigation, reduced liability for data breaches, and an enhanced user experience. Alongside addressing potential implementation challenges, it provides helpful advice for a successful deployment. This paper explores the integration of Multifactor Authentication (MFA) to enhance security. Requiring multiple identity checks, MFA fortifies security measures. It lists architectural requirements for deploying cloud computing, outlining benefits like improved user experience and enhanced security. Skillfully anticipating potential difficulties, it provides a thorough manual for effective adoption in the evolving realm of cloud-centric operations.

Author Keywords: Ciphertext Policy-Attribute based Homomorphic Encryption algorithm (CP-ABHE)

articleTitle: Advancing Multilingual Communication NLP based Translational Speech to Speech Dialogue System for Indian Languages
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Today it is more crucial than ever to remove language barriers in the linked world of today. This study compares and contrasts on-demand live translation services with an emphasis on effectiveness and accuracy. It presents a workable approach to smooth multilingual communication, with a focus on Indian languages. A state-of-the-art on-call speech translation system built on a sentence-level Neural Machine Translation (NMT) model is revealed in this work. The NMT approach translates individual sentences, as opposed to previous algorithms that work with full documents, guaranteeing accuracy and context awareness. NMT, BERT, and XL Net are also compared, emphasizing their unique qualities and areas of use. To facilitate easy communication in chosen languages, this model supports Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Urdu, Bengali, and English. This helps address the linguistic variety of India. Its versatility and efficacy are a result of intensive training on a wide range of language pairings, highlighting the contribution of technology to intercultural communication. The study emphasizes how the NMT-based on-call voice translation system improves commu-nication accessibility in our multicultural, globalized society by bridging linguistic gaps, particularly in Indian languages. In addition, a unique application of multithreading has been employed to lower latency by concurrently executing the transcription and translation operations. Research shows that when multithreading is used, the time required for a translation decreases to 93.82 seconds from an initial 137 seconds. This helps to some extent with the latency issue

articleTitle: Mobile Application Development for Plant Disease Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The use of deep learning in plant disease recognition can help to avoid the drawbacks of artificially selecting disease spot features. Existing system lacks real time detection of plant disease standing as a barrier to the usage of the existing systems. Manual detection will consume time and labor work because the leaf of each plant is to be verified and sent to the official research and the results are to be produced. To automate this, the proposed system is implemented on an android application where the farmer or any user can scan the leaf that he is suspicious of having a disease and the application would show the name of the disease on real time both in English and Tamil. Also the system suggests the amount and the name of the chemical to be added to keep a check on the health of crops, soil and the consumers.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of AE-RBM Based Pedestrian Detectors in Autonomous Vehicles: Substantial Issues and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Autonomous vehicles' rising profile is a reflection of the widespread interest in them. Improved dependability, reduced fuel consumption, cost savings, and enhanced passenger convenience are all benefits of these cars. However, autonomous vehicles must first have their functionality problems resolved before they can be extensively used on major routes. Pedestrian detection is a crucial component in autonomous vehicles that helps to avoid accidents. Preprocessing, feature extraction, and model training all rely on proper sequencing. A number of filters, such as the Median, Histogram, Dilation and Erosion, Gaussian, mean, and others, can be used to smooth out images before lane marking recognition. Haar wavelet and LBP are the components that make up feature extraction. In order to train for AE-RBM, one must have precise control over the attributes. This method looks so much more modern than the RBM and AE algorithms of today. The results demonstrated a notable enhancement in accuracy, reaching 95.84%.

articleTitle: Stellar Data Analysis and Deep Space Data Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This paper focuses on developing an advanced Stellar Data Analysis and Deep Space Data Analysis System, leveraging the power of machine learning and deep learning algorithms. Utilizing cutting-edge techniques such as artificial neural networks, random forest regression, and other sophisticated models as VGG-19,ResNet-50, the system aims to enhance our understanding of celestial phenomena by analysing stellar data. It encompasses the application of these algorithms to decipher complex patterns and anomalies in deep space data, contributing to a more comprehensive comprehension of astronomical observations. The integration of advanced machine learning and deep learning technologies empowers the system to efficiently process vast datasets, providing valuable insights into stellar dynamics, celestial objects, improves celestial object classification by overcoming the vanishing gradient problem, and deep space events. This initiative represents a significant step toward optimizing data analysis methodologies for astronomical research and exploration.

articleTitle: SMSavvy - A System to Enhance the Capabilities of Feature Phones Using Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: A large part of our daily lives is spent online, consuming services provided over the Internet. Most Institutions and Corporate Organizations both private and public rely on the Internet to discern critical information, services and utilities. The Internet has thus become a central figure governing human life. Connectivity to the Internet however requires relevant hardware and network infrastructure. Basic knowledge of the web is also critical to navigating through the Internet. Access to Internet capable devices, adequate network infrastructure and basic knowhow of using the web are the main hindrances faced by developing countries like India in extending the outreach of the Internet. Individuals within lower income brackets are notably impacted by the three aforementioned factors. This results in a scenario where they possess feature phones or outdated mobile devices that lack compatibility with contemporary internet standards. Additionally, the financial constraints they face often render them unable to afford high-speed internet data plans. This digital disparity significantly restricts their access to the advantages of the digital landscape. In this Paper we aim to develop a prototype, which we call SMSavvy that can help provide access to Artificial Intelligence powered chatbots such as ChatGPT through short message service (SMS) interface in feature phones. We do this by using Desktop Automation and Webscraping. An Automation script running on a remote server connected to the internet carries out the request received through SMS from the feature phone. It scrapes the response from the AI chatbot and encapsulates it into an SMS before sending it back to the user. By doing this, reliance on fast internet is overcome and so is the need to purchase expensive internet capable devices curtailed. This prototype can pave the way for more sophisticated and larger cloud based SMS automation systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Agricultural Efficiency and Sustainability Through Advanced IoT and AI-Driven Precision Farming Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Water scarcity significantly impacts agriculture, especially in arid regions where effective water management is essential for maintaining crop yields and livelihoods. This proposed system introduces a comprehensive integrated irrigation system that leverages ground-based sensor networks, drone technology, and artificial intelligence (AI) to directly tackle this challenge. Utilizing advanced technologies like soil moisture sensors and multispectral drone imagery, the system enables AI algorithms to precisely assess irrigation needs. This approach not only enhances water efficiency but also boosts crop health and productivity. It enables real-time adjustments to irrigation techniques, ensuring the best possible water distribution adjusted to the unique requirements of different crop sections and significantly cutting down on water waste. Furthermore, the farm management platform provides farmers with extensive data access, enabling them to make sustainable and well-informed decisions regarding their farming practices. This proposed system aims to transform farming practices in arid regions by addressing the pressing issue of water scarcity. Enhancing tolerance to the effects of climate change, ensuring economic sustainability, and promoting resource efficiency are the main objectives.

articleTitle: Bimodal Framework for Cardiac Arrhythmia Analysis using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Medical image analysis plays a critical role in the early detection and treatment planning for various health conditions, including cardiac arrhythmias. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have shown immense potential in automating this process. This study introduces a novel approach to medical image analysis, specifically the classification of cardiac arrhythmias, through the creation of a hybrid model that combines the strengths of two CNN architectures: PPG 1D model and Spectrogram from ECG model. PPG 1D model, known for its computational efficiency and model size, is utilized as the primary feature extractor. This architecture excels at capturing essential image features at multiple scales while mitigating the risk of over fitting. In contrast, DenseNet, celebrated for its dense connections between layers, enhances feature reuse and gradient flow, ultimately improving feature representation. The hybrid model is developed by fine-tuning the pre-trained PPG 1D model with Spectrogram from ECG based classification. To further enhance the model's robustness and generalization capabilities, data augmentation techniques are implemented. This augmentation process ensures the model's effectiveness in handling variations in medical images. The results of this study demonstrates a substantial improvement in the accuracy of cardiac arrhythmia classification. This enhancement holds great importance as it equips healthcare professionals with a reliable tool for diagnosing cardiac arrhythmias more precisely. In summary, the potential of combining PPG 1D model and Spectrogram from ECG model significantly enhances the accuracy of cardiac arrhythmia classification. This innovative approach streamlines clinical workflows, paving the way for earlier and more accurate diagnoses of cardiac arrhythmias, leading to improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Constructing the City of the Future: A Smart City Vision With the help of 5G Networks and the IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The concept of smart cities has the potential to revolutionise city life with the advent of 5G networks and the IoT. This article examines the potential integration of 5G and IoT technology into future urban planning to enhance efficiency, sustainability, and people’ quality of life. A comprehensive system requires the integration of intelligent transportation, energy management, healthcare, and urban planning. Issues related to cybersecurity, infrastructure needs, and regulatory frameworks are also comprehensively analyzed. This research sheds light on the socioeconomic impacts of smart cities through theoretical analysis and case studies. Smart cities comprise several benefits such as enhanced public services, heightened economic competitiveness, and improved resource allocation efficiency. Subsequently, the study explores the effects of the growth of smart cities on privacy, data governance, and digital inclusion. Ultimately, the integration of 5G with the Internet of Things has the potential to significantly revolutionize urban environments, enhancing their sustain ability, resilience, and inclusivity. Connectivity provides cities with the chance to promote innovation, engage stakeholders, and create a fairer and more enj oyable community in the digital age.

articleTitle: Safeguarding Biodiversity: Remote Forest Poaching Camp Detection with CNN and Spatial Transformer Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The increasing threat of poaching continues to endanger global biodiversity, calling for innovative and timely measures in detection as well as interventions. In response, this study presents a novel approach to methodology that utilizes high-resolution optical satellite imagery along with an advanced hybrid deep learning model comprising Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Spatial Transformer networks (STN). The broad dataset of 25,000 images reflects the complexities of poaching activities which include temporary camps, human movement, vehicles, and abandoned camps. The hybrid model rises as an outstanding tool, which demonstrates great performance with an overall accuracy of 95.90%. Accordingly, precision, recall, and Fl-score measurements are diligently used for every class that show how well the model is performing in distinguishing complex patterns connected to various stages of poaching. Most significantly, the impressive recall of 96.52 % for detection temporary camps, is a testament to the model's proactive nature in early-onset threat mitigation - this being one of the key aspects of poaching threats control. Notably, a comprehensive analysis using confusion matrices not only verifies the accuracy of classification capabilities but also offers several subtle insights into model performance towards different classes. This fine-grained knowledge helps in the implementation of pertinent adjustments that improve model responsiveness to different environmental levels and types of comparative studies in the light of other models or baseline methods emphasizing how better is the proposed hybrid model about its several multi-classification tasks that are associated with poaching detection.

articleTitle: Prediction of Cardiovascular Disease Risk in the General Population: A GSA-ELM Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Medical treatment is a need since it ensures our continued existence as a species. Conditions affecting the heart and blood arteries are collectively known as cardiovascular disease. Decisions regarding the appropriate medicines for people at high risk for cardiovascular disease were informed by early methods of illness prediction. Machine learning algorithms are crucial for creating reliable forecasts of cardiac problems because of the abundance of available health care data. The proposed method is based on three primary phases: preprocessing, feature extraction, and model training. To lessen the impact of distracting noise, HD statistics use filtering and de-noising during the preprocessing phase. In order to extract features, the gray-level Co-Occurrence Matrix is employed. Next, GSA-ELM models are trained based on the retrieved characteristics. Compared to GSA and ELM, the two most popular alternatives, the suggested technique is better. They were able to reach a maximum accuracy of 95.74% by implementing the suggested technique.

articleTitle: GPS-Guided, Solar-Powered AGVs for Streamlined Industrial Logistics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The work suggests a novel approach to revolutionise the strategy to integrate solar-powered automated guided vehicles (AGVs) with GPS technology in order to transform industrial logistics. The two main issues facing material handling operations that this creative combination seeks to solve are operational efficiency and environmental sustainability. The AGVs provide a sustainable energy solution by utilizing solar energy, which lowers operating costs and lowers carbon emissions in line with international environmental goals. Furthermore, the integration of GPS technology facilitates accurate navigation, reducing the need for human intervention and streamlining logistical processes. Hence, improves operating efficiency even more by leading to more precise and effective route planning. The work presented shows how solar-powered, GPS-guided AGVs may dramatically increase scalability, lower costs, and improve energy efficiency in a variety of industrial settings. A significant advancement in the direction of more eco-friendly and effective industrial logistics procedures has been made possible by this creative combination of GPS and solar technology.

articleTitle: Design & Implementation of a Vehicle Detection and Tracking System Utilizing YOLOv8 and Google Maps API
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: This research paper presents a robust vehicle detection and tracking system that effectively leverages the powerful YOLOv8 object detection algorithm in conjunction with the Google Maps API. The proposed system aims to accurately identify and track vehicles, providing valuable insights for diverse applications such as vehicle tracing and surveillance. Through the seamless integration of YOLOv8 and the Google Maps API, the system demonstrates efficient vehicle information extraction from video streams, enabling intuitive visualization and mapping of detected vehicles on a geographic platform. Experimental evaluations affirm the system's effectiveness in accurate vehicle detection and tracking, highlighting its potential as a valuable tool for surveillance-related applications for smart cities. The experimental evaluations conducted on a standardized dataset demonstrate the system's capability to achieve an average vehicle detection accuracy of 95 % and a tracking efficiency with an aver-age processing time of 100 milliseconds per frame. These results underscore the practical viability and real-world applicability of the proposed system in enhancing transportation management and surveillance operations.

articleTitle: Efficient DNA Sequence Identification: A Classification Approach Integrating Gaussian RBM
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Using machine learning techniques, this article examines cancer patients' DNA sequences. Cancer is certainly one of the most common and devastating diseases in the contemporary era, with a large number of new cases and deaths every year. Many people lose their lives each year to this terrible illness. Methods to combat this illness are the focus of intense investigation by scientists from a wide range of fields. Recently, machine learning has improved the analysis of cancer patients' DNA sequences. Sequencing is crucial for preprocessing, feature extraction, and model training. Among the preprocessing stages is cleaning up the sequence, which entails eliminating PCR repetitions, impurities, and vectors. Feature extraction has been carried out on each DNA sequence in order to retrieve statistical characteristics. It is of utmost importance to regulate features accurately when training a Gaussian RBM. A grade of 96.44% demonstrated a considerable improvement in accuracy, according to the results.

articleTitle: Optimizing Positive Workplace Emotions: Prophet-ARIMA-LSTM Solutions for Teachers” Job Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Since many nations have a serious scarcity of qualified educators and high rates of teacher turnover, it is to everyone's benefit when teachers love what they do for a career. This is because engaged teachers are more invested in their work, have better health in general, and are less likely to leave. The connection between health and happiness on the job is better understood with the help of this suggestion. A wide variety of operations depend on sequencing, including preprocessing, feature selection, and training models. The steps involved in preprocessing include noise filtering, aggregation, and discretization. When selecting features for positive emotion recognition, it is possible to utilize a collection that contains features that are irrelevant or redundant. Training a Prophet-ARIMA-LSTM model requires careful consideration of which attributes to use. The proposed method outperforms two cutting-edge algorithms, ARIMA and LSTM, in every metric. With a grade of 97.34%, the figures showed a significant improvement.

articleTitle: Benign vs. Malignant Brain Tumors: An In-Depth Review Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The brain's complex web of connections is essential for enabling functions like movement, sensation, and memory. The intricate and delicate nature of the brain underscores its significance as a critical organ in the human body. Uncontrolled cell growths, or tumors, can significantly affect the brain's operation, similar to their effects on other body parts. Without timely detection and proper treatment, these tumors pose a serious health risk, potentially leading to life-threatening conditions. Brain tumors have two main classes: Malignant Tumors and Benign Tumors. The tumors that are cancerous, and have the capability to spread within the brain or to other body regions fall in the category of Malignant Tumors, whereas the tumors that are non-cancerous and do not spread from their original location fall under the category of Benign Tumors. Identifying these tumors poses a significant challenge, especially within the brain's complex structure, complicating the diagnosis process for medical professionals. Although MRI scans and CT scans are positively effective in determining the type, size, and location of tumors, there remains an essential need for more accurate detection methods. Advanced Deep Learning algorithms and Machine Learning algorithms are two examples of the increasingly complex algorithms that have been developed in response to the growing requirement for precise and accurate tumor identification. These algorithms are essential for improving the precision and accuracy of detection. Between 2018 and 2023, researchers have developed various techniques leveraging these algorithms for brain tumor identification, offering improved precision, effectiveness, and efficiency over traditional methods. This review analyzed 12 such research studies, using their findings to establish the groundwork for discussing methodologies, limitations, and results. The research specifically focuses on employing cutting-edge deep-learning algorithms to analyze Tl-weighted MRI data for brain tumor detection. This study aims to offer a detailed overview of the latest advancements in brain tumor identification techniques. It aims to provide insightful observations and recommendations for future researchers to improve the precision and make the rate at which tumor diagnosis methods work faster, potentially leading to a quicker and more accurate detection of brain tumors, thereby saving lives.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach of Ecommerce for Sales Prediction Using Hybrid ABC and AdaBoost Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: For online stores to offer speedier shipping times, precise sales forecasting is essential. Online advertising campaigns and the competitive nature of comparable but distinct products are only two of many potential variables that could make accurate sales forecasting more difficult. Typically, these characteristics are disregarded in this approach since traditional methods that rely on time series analysis primarily take sales data into account. Preprocessing, feature selection, and training the model must be carried out in an exact sequence. Data quality concerns, missing information, and product grouping are all part of the preprocessing process. In feature selection, a statistical method known as principal component analysis (PCA) is used to reduce the dimensionality of a dataset that contains multiple linked variables. To train the model, Hybrid-ABC-AdaBoost was utilized. Incredibly, the data show that an accuracy of 97.22 % was reached.

articleTitle: An Efficient Method for Water Quality Prediction for Ungauged River Catchment Under Dual Scenarios Based on CNN-BiRNN-A Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: All life on Earth depends on water, which makes up more than 80% of its surface. Harmful water pollution has emerged as a result of the fast deterioration of water quality caused by increasing industrialization and urbanization. Most water quality estimations need time-consuming and costly statistical calculations, rendering current real-time monitoring efforts useless. There is a predetermined sequence in which to carry out preprocessing, feature extraction, and model training. An important part of the preprocessing phase of data analysis is data normalization using the z-score approach. This step is vital for getting high-quality findings. The suggested method improved the accuracy of water pollution process classification by employing VGG for feature extraction. The model was trained using a CNN-BiRNN-A technique. In comparison to state-of-the-art CNN and BiRNN, our approach seems fresh. With a 97.63 % accuracy percentage, the numbers demonstrated a notable enhancement.

articleTitle: State-of-the-Art of Prediction of Stress Levels in the Workplace Based on MLP-CNN Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: When both mental and bodily functions deviate from their usual patterns of action, symptoms of stress become apparent. Management style and a lack of autonomy over one's work are two of the many potential sources of stress in the workplace. Both employers and employees benefit from manageable levels of stress. Both individual and organisational objectives can be advanced using this method. Workers' physical, mental, and emotional health may all take a hit when they're under too much stress. Psychological techniques that make use of questionnaires provide one approach to stress evaluation. Model training, feature extraction, feature selection, and preprocessing all rely on sequencing. The term “data preprocessing” describes the steps taken to prepare raw data for usage in machine learning or deep learning models. The process of feature extraction is crucial in order to construct new features from pre-existing ones in the dataset. Feature selection is the process of selecting features that will be most helpful in predicting the results of the classification. Careful handling of features is required during training of an MLP-CNN model. The proposed method completely outperforms the state-of-the-art algorithms, MLP and CNN. An astounding 98.43% accuracy grade was shown in the results, indicating significant improvement.

articleTitle: Real-Time Parking System with Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Traditional parking systems often struggle with inefficient space usage, limited visibility, and unsatisfactory user experiences due to manual monitoring and lack of real-time status updates specially the underground parking spaces that are common in malls and theatres. We propose a system that addresses the limitations of traditional parking systems, emphasizing inefficient space utilization, limited visibility, and suboptimal user experiences. To tackle these challenges, it introduces an Intelligent Parking System employing Infrared (IR) sensors strategically positioned for precise real-time car detection. By leveraging a centralized processing unit, manual monitoring issues are resolved, enabling swift data analysis. The system's dynamic web interface offers users real-time parking status, historical data, and trends, mitigating uncertainties about spot availability. Integrating IR sensors, Raspberry Pi Pico W, and React JS methodologies, the IPS fosters a scalable design, accommodating additional sensors and presenting a holistic solution to contemporary parking dilemmas. This approach not only maximizes parking space utilization but also enhances urban mobility, promising a comprehensive and adaptive answer to modern parking challenges. We have researched a smart parking system using OpenCV as well. Our proposed system includes capturing and integrating the footage of parking spaces with an Object-Detection Algorithm using OpenCv’ The real-time availability of the parking spaces can be displayed through our Web Page.

articleTitle: Automated Diabetic Retinopathy Identification Through Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy, a significant contributor to vision loss, arises due to prolonged and cumulative harm to the retina's small blood vessels, leading to blindness. Diabetic Retinopathy complication was caused by uncontrolled diabetes. Fundus images are the sources used to analyze this disease by a medical practitioner, but it takes a time consuming process. Hence, computer-aided automatic detection methods are developed. But these methods are computationally expensive and not accurate to classify various stages of DR. In this article we will examine various deep learning techniques used in the identification and categorization of diabetic retinopathy. We also see the existing data sets that are employed to train and evaluate the CNN model, as well as different metrics and criteria that are employed to evaluate the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Object Recognition and Tracking System to Assist Visually Impaired: A Neural Network-Based Deep RBM Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Being able to see is fundamental to almost every aspect of our everyday lives, thus those who are visually impaired confront enormous obstacles. Thanks to recent developments in computer vision and computing, a system that can provide auditory input to visually impaired individuals regarding objects and their environments has been designed. Sequencing is crucial for preprocessing, feature selection, and model training. Although extremely accurate data input is still required for object detection, preparation is getting computationally cheaper. We were partially successful in reducing the image size by employing Gaussian Blur, which imparts a smoother appearance to the photos. We use color descriptors and Fourier transforms for feature extraction. Deep RBM training necessitates precise control over the attributes. In comparison to this method, current RBM and DNN algorithms look antiquated. The results demonstrated a notable enhancement in accuracy, reaching 98.31%.

articleTitle: Enhancing In-Vehicle Networks with CAN-FD: A study of Protocol Improvements over Classical CAN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Classical Controller Area Network (CAN) technology has been widely used in in-vehicle networks for decades. However, with the increasing complexity of modern vehicles, CAN's limitations in terms of data rates and packet sizes have become constraints. To overcome these limitations, CAN with Flexible Data Rate (CAN-FD) has been introduced as an enhanced protocol that is compatible with existing CAN networks. This paper provides a comparative study between classical CAN and CAN-FD protocols. The key differences include CAN-FD's ability to transmit larger payloads up to 64 bytes per packet and achieve higher bit rates up to 10 Mbps. Major protocol improvements include the flexible data rate for the data field in CAN-FD frames, bandwidth allocation for larger data segments, and a higher maximum baud rate for faster arbitration. These enhancements significantly improve the usable data throughput and latency compared to classical CAN. New capabilities enabled by CAN-FD include transmitting larger messages and software files for advanced automotive applications and reprogramming. Overall, CAN-FD provides substantial performance gains while maintaining compatibility with existing CAN networks, making it an attractive upgrade path for enhancing modern in-vehicle networks.

articleTitle: Advanced Reinforcement Learning Based Penetration Testing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Penetration testing is a technique that involves the identification and exploitation of security flaws by simulating real world attacks to find security loopholes. Manual pentesting is a tedious and time consuming process. With applications being developed within weeks and the rapid growth of cybercrime, automated pentesting is the need of the hour. This research focuses on training the pentesting agent using three different reinforcement learning algorithms - Proximal Policy Optimization(PPO), Deep Q-Network (DQN) and Ad-vantageous Actor-Critic (A2C) to discover the suitable technique to perform penetration testing. The goal is to create an agent which is capable of exploiting the vulnerabilities in a host system in an effective manner. The training occurs against various vulnerable machines to identify the optimal exploit path with each algorithm and their convergence is compared. The study finds that Advantageous Actor-Critic has the best convergence rate compared to the performance of Deep Q-Network and Proximal Policy Optimization. The time duration and resource consumption is minimal proving that manual penetration testing is old and outdated and automating the process is tedious but worthy and effective.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Effective Detection and Prediction of Sophisticated Cyber Attacks Using the Stacked Attention GRU and BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The dynamic and sophisticated cyber threats of today's quickly expanding cybersecurity landscape are surpassing the effectiveness of traditional security solutions. Organizations must take a proactive stance in danger identification and mitigation if they are to successfully tackle these new difficulties. Threat intelligence (TI), or the real-time sharing of cyber threat data, is crucial for both proactive defense and quick reaction to cyberattacks.
