This study describes a comprehensive approach that includes feature selection, data preparation, and model training for threat intelligence-based cyber security. Normalization and standardization are two preprocessing methods that maximize data representation for efficient analysis. Principal component analysis is one of the feature selection techniques used to find the most pertinent variables for model training. A Stacked BiLSTM-A-GRU model is trained with careful respect to feature selection, guaranteeing optimal performance. A comparative examination shows that the suggested method outperforms the most advanced algorithms, with a remarkable accuracy rate of 98.71% This study emphasizes how crucial it is to use threat intelligence to have a strong cybersecurity defense against ever-changing threats.

articleTitle: The Importance of Early Detection and Risk Assessment for Chronic Disease Based on IF-ORBF-DA Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: While accurate epidemiological data is lacking, the suggested method takes into account the fact that a sizable percentage of the population is dealing with chronic kidney disease (CKD) at an early, manageable stage. Worldwide, renal replacement treatment (RRT) is becoming more popular. Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is becoming an increasingly serious clinical concern and a financial and organisational risk because to the high cost of RRT. This is the sequential order of the steps: preprocessing, feature selection, and model training. Improving the data quality relies heavily on the preprocessing step, which fixes critical issues including data encoding, missing values, and outliers. The purpose of the feature selection process is to extract the most relevant features from the initial dataset and discard the rest that aren't relevant to the job at hand. We trained this model using the IF-ORBF-DA method. It looks like this strategy is outdated compared to IF and ORBF. An astounding 96.24% accuracy percentage, clearly an improvement, as shown by the data.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Cardiovascular Care: The Role of AI, ML, and DL in Early Heart Disease Prediction and Treatment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Heart disease is one of the most common and critical health issues around the world, which makes to many deaths and illnesses. To effectively combat this disease, it is necessary to predict its presence and act in a timely manner. A light of hope has appeared in recent years with the combination of machine learning(ML), artificial intelligence(AI), and deep learning(DL), providing more precise, timely, and individualized methods to heart disease diagnosis and treatment. This substantial summary work explores the complex terrain of AI, ML, and DL for heart disease prediction. It explores the status of research at this point, focuses on practical applications, and suggests prospective routes for the future. This study seeks provide a full knowledge of the role of new technologies in cardiovascular care by reviewing the methodology, datasets, and issues in this subject. It is impossible to emphasize the value of early prediction and action. Healthcare practitioners and patients are empowered by AI, ML, and DL technologies because they provide early risk assessment, accurate diagnoses, and individualized treatment strategies. By allowing continuous monitoring via wearable devices, improving diagnostic accuracy, and assuring the interpretability of prediction models, these technologies not only save lives but also improve the standard of care. A prediction of cardiac disease using clinical data and its derivation, genetic data, imaging and wearable technologies shall, in the parts that follow, be reviewed. It will also discuss about model interpretability, feature selection and the scope of personalized treatment. Some of the limitations and challenges in this area will also be pointed out, followed by an optimistic view of the future which underlines the ability of AI, ML and DL to revolutionize the management of cardiac patients. Thus, this research points to how crucial it is to have sophisticated technology when it comes to initial diagnosis of heart disease and the subsequent management of the situation to give better hope on heart health around the world.

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Fault Detection Electric Power System Protection using SVMCNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Multiple factors outside our control can contribute to the unanticipated breakdown of electrical power networks. It is of the utmost importance to prevent unforeseen power system issues from affecting other components of the protective system. It is the job of the protective systems to identify and categorize potentially dangerous voltage and/or current lines. To isolate the malfunctioning line, utilize the protection relay to trigger the circuit breaker. An SVM-CNN architecture is presented in this study for the purpose of detecting power outages in transmission lines. When it comes to preprocessing, feature selection, and training models, the correct sequence of activities is crucial. For anomaly-based fault detection algorithms to accurately represent and understand the data, data preprocessing is essential. Feature selection makes the process more feasible by reducing the entire data volume and helping HIF detection home in on the most relevant features. The results were evident with an accuracy improvement reaching 95.70%.

articleTitle: Towards Mental stress Detection in University Students Based on RBF and Extreme Learning Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: A lot of individuals associate stressful situations with bad experiences. It is concerning that mental health issues are so common, particularly among younger people. The once carefree generation is now under a great deal of stress. Modern society's elevated stress levels are associated with an array of serious health issues, such as an increased risk of suicide, heart disease, depression, and stroke. Within the scope of our research, we are attempting to quantify the degree to which students experience internet-related anxiety in the seven days leading up to an exam. Model training, feature selection, and preprocessing are all tremendously dependent on sequencing. Images with consistent size and intensity can be achieved by removing noise and blinks during this preprocessing step. Classifier performance improvement via feature selection aims to normalize and increase accuracy by utilizing favorable attributes. Feature selection is crucial during the training of a StressNet-C-BiLSTM model. When compared to two state-of-the-art algorithms, BiLSTM and CNN, the suggested technique outperforms them. The results demonstrated a significant improvement, with an accuracy rate of 97.58%.

articleTitle: A Secure and Privacy Oriented Implementation of Electronic Health Records
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Electronic health records (EHRs) are digital versions of patient's medical histories, diagnoses, treatments, and outcomes. EHRs can improve the quality and efficiency of healthcare services by enabling easy access and sharing of health information among different parties, such as patients, doctors, and insurers. However, EHRs also pose significant challenges in terms of security, privacy, and interoperability. Traditional centralized systems for storing and managing EHRs are vulnerable to cyberattacks, data breaches, and unauthorized access. Blockchain technology is a promising solution for overcoming these challenges and creating a secure, decentralized, and immutable platform for EHRs. Blockchain ensures the integrity and authenticity of the data by using digital signatures and consensus mechanisms. Blockchain also enables transparency and traceability of the data by creating a permanent and verifiable record of the transactions. This project proposes a novelblockchain based electronic health record (EHR) system thatincorporates the perspectives of patients, doctors, and insurers. This system has several advantages over the existing solutions for EHRs. The system provides a secure, decentralized, and immutable platform for storing and sharing EHRs. Patients have full control over their own EHRs and can grant permissions to authorized parties to view or create EHRs. Doctors are also required to sign the report part of the EHR with their private key to ensure their involvement and authenticity. Insurers have the option to verify the authenticity and integrity of the EHRs by comparing the doctor's address in the EHR and the doctor's address received after decrypting the EHR using the doctor's public key. Insurers also have claims processing and payment procedures gateways.

articleTitle: Short-Lived Social Vehicular Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The Short-Lived Social Vehicular Network (SSVN) represents an innovative fusion of social and vehicular networks, offering a comprehensive solution for security, safety, and alleviating boredom during common route travels plagued by traffic congestion. SSVN addresses the common issue of passengers and drivers feeling bored during traffic jams by enabling the formation of social groups among travelers. These groups serve as platforms for sharing interests, hobbies, and pertinent road safety or traffic-related information. In the SSVN model, passengers find an entertainment outlet through social group clustering, organized based on shared interests and hobbies among travelers traversing the same path. The paper proposes a mathematical model for the formation of these social groups, accompanied by the determination of trustworthiness among group members, employing principles of Graph Theory. This trustworthiness assessment enhances the reliability and cohesion of the social groups within SSVN, fostering a sense of security and camaraderie among travelers.

articleTitle: Air Pollution Monitoring and Purifying System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: In this paper, we describe the design and assessment of an Internet of Things (IoT)-based smart air pollution moni-toring system. The system provides accurate, fast, and complete information on air quality through real-time data collecting and processing. The outcomes show excellent accuracy and dependability with low energy usage. Scalability, affordability, and real-time data sharing are three of the system's benefits over traditional monitoring systems, as demonstrated by a comparative analysis. Still, more work has to be done on the abstract to make the relevance and main conclusions of the study clear.

articleTitle: Face Mask Detection and Alert System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has underscored the importance of preventive measures, with the use of face masks being a crucial aspect of controlling the virus's spread. Thus, in the response to the global imperative to curb the spread of infectious diseases, particularly in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic, this research paper delves into the realm of face mask detection and alert systems. With the ubiquity of technology, the development of automated solutions for ensuring adherence to mask-wearing protocols has become most necessary. This paper provides a thorough examination of existing methodologies for face mask detection, ranging from image& video-based approaches to sophisticated deep learning models. Additionally, explores the integration of alert systems into these detection frameworks, emphasizing real- time processing considerations and user interface design. The review incorporates case studies, ethical considerations, and privacy implications, offering a comprehensive overview of the current state of the art. By elucidating the challenges, successes, and future directions, this research paper contributes to the discourse on leveraging technology for public health measures and sets the stage for continued advancements in face mask detection systems and also provides a comprehensive review of the state-of-the-art in face mask detection technologies and explores the design.

articleTitle: A Transformer-Based Deep Convolutional Network for Heart Anomaly Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Heart disease is the main factor leading to death, and it is crucial to identify it at an early stage. Nevertheless, the standard diagnostic protocols for heart failure are costly and require a significant amount of time. Conventional machine learning methods necessitate effective data cleansing, feature selection, and complex data processing. This study introduces a novel approach for forecasting cardiac disease by utilizing diverse datasets. The foundation of this methodology relies on a transition-based encoder-decoder framework, which acquires the ability to forecast cardiovascular events by analyzing medical operations. The findings of this research demonstrate that electronic components have the potential to enhance cardiac parameters by utilizing tabular data. This approach shows potential for impoverished regions. By utilizing the FT transformer, we were able to attain an accuracy of 88.6%. In contrast, the lightweight GBM model, which does not necessitate prior information, acquired an accuracy of 86.4%.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Si0.8Ge0.2 Double-Gate MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The sole objective of the microelectronics industry nowadays is to accommodate many transistors on a single chip, particularly in the nanometer region which is done using scaling. Scaling has given rise to a significant problem in the form of short channel effects, which are visible as decrement in drive current and an increment in leakage current. To overcome them, we came across a double-gate configuration of MOSFET with Si0.8Ge0.2. simulation using the Cogenda Visual TCAD tool, analyzing the transfer input and output characteristics of Si0.8Ge0.2 double-gate N-MOSFET. From analysis, we investigate and estimate parameters DIBL, GIDL, MMCR, subthreshold slope, threshold voltage, and volume inversion since they are very helpful in determining the performance of configuration. From that, we get results in terms of Si0.8Ge0.2 as a channel material in double-gate configuration performing better in comparison to Si0.9Ge0.1 and existing Si as a channel material in double-gate configuration.

articleTitle: Integrated Railway Infrastructure Optimization and Control System: Leveraging IoT for Advanced Railway Management and Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The Railway Track Tracer technology for Creature Detection is a technology that detects fractures in railway tracks. This method will assist in preventing numerous train accidents. This device routinely checks railway rails with a camera and DC motors to detect fractures and take appropriate action to avoid accidents. The Internet of Things is the most studied field, and its applications are endless. Internet of Things (IOT) has been implemented to provide up-to-date updates on railway management. In this mode, an IR sensor is used to check the availability of the platform. This system is used to update the platform availability to the upcoming train to avoid or to prevent accidents by the usage of Zigbee, which acts as wireless communication from station to train and from train to station and detects fire and automatic engine detachment. To update the platform availability. There has been an upsurge in railway accidents caused mainly by track quandaries. That might be a misalignment, an obstacle, a crack in one of the track's sides, or some other fault with the track. So, keeping track of all these difficulties is a time-consuming chore for a person. The scope of the paper encompasses detecting the cracks on rail tracks using network signals - checking the platform availability, Zigbee for the communication, fire sensor for detecting the fire ultrasonic sensors, and Nodemcu can be used. The Railway Track Tracer technology for Creature Detection is a technology that detects fractures in railway tracks. This method will assist in preventing numerous train accidents.

articleTitle: Collaborative Recommender Systems for Building Automation: A Hybrid ANN-FOA Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The rapid evolution of energy and sustainability regulations pertaining to the constructed environment is a direct result of the pressing worldwide environmental crises. A renewed focus on resource efficiency is being fostered within the construction industry by innovative ideas like “Nearly Zero Energy Building” (nZEB). That is why it is necessary to evaluate the building's performance thoroughly during its entire lifecycle. According to the data, there is usually a significant discrepancy between the predicted performance in the design stage and the real performance in operation. The reason behind this is that errors might occur at any point in a building's lifespan. Feature extraction, preprocessing, and training models all rely on correct sequencing. The purpose of preprocessing is to improve the reliability of a dataset by removing inaccurate or missing data, such as outliers. In order to extract features, GLCM and the Wavelet Scattering Transform are being utilised. For training hybrid ANN-FOA models, exact control over the attributes is essential. This approach appears to be rather novel when compared to the cutting-edge FOA and ANN algorithms. With a precision of 97.35 percent, the results demonstrated a significant improvement.

articleTitle: Diabetic Foot Ulcer Detection using Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Diabetic foot ulcers (D FU) pose a significant health risk to people with diabetes, requiring early and accurate detection for rapid intervention. In the context of this research, we present a system for automated detection employing (CNN) deep convolutional neural network (CNN) in Efficient Network architecture. This model leverages the power of transfer learning by initializing with pre-trained weights from ImageNet, allowing the model to learn relevant features from a wide variety of images. A dataset consisting of positive samples (DFU) and negative samples (healthy feet) is collected and preprocessed for training. Through customization and fine-tuning of the Performance Network model, we enabled the model to distinguish important features associated with foot ulcers during exercise. Although further validation and collaboration with healthcare experts is necessary, this deep CNN Efficiency Network model shows significant potential as a supporting tool to help improve detection and manage diabetic foot ulcers, thereby reducing the risk of complications associated with the disease.

articleTitle: Stress Management Through Workplace Associations with Productivity and Mood: The Impact of Learning Experience Based on Hybrid RF-GA-DNN Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Several businesses have lately implemented plans to increase staff hours, streamline operations, and better manage workloads in response to the fast economic boom. They want to stabilise the market and improve their own companies' fortunes at the same time. Based on the theory of psychological capital, this method examines how an individual's positive psychological capital relates to their ability to manage stress at work. Three distinct phases make up the process: preprocessing, feature selection, and training the model. Preprocessing includes both personalisation and SOM; nevertheless, SOM yields more precise results. In feature selection, a subset of distinct features is chosen from a bigger pool of features in order to construct a classification or regression model. Using the RF-GA-DNN approach, it trained this model. Comparing this method to GA and DNN makes it look antiquated. With a staggering accuracy percentage of 95.03 %, the data plainly demonstrates progress.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Cirrhosis Diagnosis: A Machine Learning Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Cirrhosis manifests as a condition wherein healthy liver tissue is gradually replaced by scar tissue, resulting in a decline in liver function. This ailment frequently correlates with autoimmune disorders, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, excessive alcohol intake, and persistent liver conditions such as hepatitis B or C. As cirrhosis progresses, it can cause liver failure and various complications such as ascites, portal hypertension, hepatic encephalopathy, and an increased risk of liver cancer. Since the liver plays a crucial role in filtering blood and performing essential functions, individuals with acute liver failure are more prone to infections, particularly those affecting the circulatory, respiratory, and urinary systems. Kidney failure is a common consequence of liver failure, especially in cases of acetaminophen overdose, as this medication can damage both the liver and kidneys. In the realm of healthcare, the integration of machine learning has enabled the early prediction of liver cirrhosis using historical datasets. The aim of this research is to create a machine learning model that utilizes artificial intelligence to forecast the occurrence of liver cirrhosis using supplied data. By employing hyperparameter tuning techniques to enhance accuracy, this research employs machine learning techniques like logistic regression and Gradient Boosted Classifier using XGBoost. Utilizing GridSearch within XGBoost, this research work achieves an impressive accuracy rate of 98%, accompanied by precision, recall, and F1-scores of 96%, 97%, and 96%, respectively. These findings hold promise for the advancement of more sophisticated and accurate liver cirrhosis prediction models, thereby benefiting researchers in the field.

articleTitle: An Efficient Method for Strategic Human Resource Management Based on BERT-BiLSTM and Siamese Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Using an evolutionary and historical lens, this system delves into the history of strategic human resource management (SHRM) literature. It has organized this body of work into seven main categories that reflect the changes in emphasis and approach over the past 30 years. During this period, the discipline began to take shape, developing a strong conceptual foundation and growing into an area that has a major influence on studies of human resource management and related fields. Three steps make up this suggested approach: cleaning up the data, choosing the features, and training the model. The process of preparing data for input into a DM algorithm is known as data preparation. The proposed approach employ CFS in feature selection. Feature selection is an essential part of training a BERT-BiLSTM-Siamese model. The proposed method surpasses the state-of-the-art using only publicly available data. The results showed a 96.35% boost in accuracy.

articleTitle: A Novel Meta-Learning Ensemble Framework for Cancer Classification Using Convolution Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Detecting cancer at an early stage is vital because it is a complicated global health crisis that killed 10 million people in 2018. Creating more accurate technology that provides information about the patient's cancer through early diagnosis helps clinicians make better-informed treatment decisions. This research delves deeply into a number of malignancies. A solid overview of machine-learning(ML) and deep-learning(DL) strategies employed in cancer research is also presented in this work. The paper also suggested a multi-neural ensemble learning strategy that relies on stacking to improve the anticipation performance on 8datasets. These datasets include prostate, non-small cell lung cancer survival, cervical, mesothelioma, and Wisconsin breast cancer. The 3real-time cancer datasets from the Jammu and Kashmir region-lung, ovarian, and leukemia-are also examined in this work. Our study's methodology achieved the highest level of anticipation accuracy across all types of cancer datasets, according to the simulation findings. Also, statistical validation of the proposed approach has been done. The researchers set out to create and test a model that could integrate anthropometric, clinical, imaging, and genetic data to make predictions about cancer risk. When compared to homogenous model-multi-modal and uni-modal frameworks, the simulation results show that the suggested framework is more accurate.

articleTitle: Enhancing Transportation Safety with YOLO-Based CNN Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Our project, titled Enhancing Transportation Safety with YOLO-based CNN Autonomous Vehicles”, pioneers a transformative approach to autonomous driving. Through the fusion of advanced machine learning techniques, specifically the YOLO-based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm, with meticulously selected hardware components, including Raspberry Pi 4B and IR sensors, our system addresses critical objectives such as object recognition, lane detection, and traffic signal and signboard detection, pothole detection. By leveraging diverse image datasets and optimizing the YOLO-based CNN algorithm, our system achieves exceptional accuracy and efficiency in environmental perception and navigation. Key features such as real-time object detection and precise lane detection contribute to safe navigation through complex traffic scenarios. With potential applications across automotive, logistics, and transportation industries, our project represents a significant advancement in autonomous driving technology. By prioritizing safety and efficiency, our YOLO-based CNN autonomous vehicle system holds promise for revolutionizing transportation systems and enhancing road safety worldwide.

articleTitle: A Study on Isogeny Based Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Quantum cryptography enhances security and addresses vulnerabilities present in traditional cryptography, thereby providing better protection against potential risks posed by quantum computing. As quantum computing progresses, the feasibility of quantum cryptanalysis increases, necessitating the development of various post-quantum cryptography techniques. These techniques include cryptography that relies on lattices, codes, hash functions, multivariate polynomials, and isogenies, all aimed at ensuring stronger security measures. This paper focuses specifically on isogeny-based cryptography, a novel branch of cryptography that utilizes isogenies between elliptic curves to construct cryptographic tools. These schemes are known for their speed, efficiency, and resistance to quantum attacks. Our research delves into the latest advancements in isogeny-based cryptography, exploring the challenges and opportunities for future investigation. We firmly believe that isogeny-based cryptography holds great potential in shaping the future of cryptography, and we encourage fellow researchers to delve into this captivating field.

articleTitle: Truth or Deception: “Advancements in Fake News Detection Technology.”
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Over the last 10 years, the categorization of phoney news has expanded significantly due to the ease with which it can be disseminated on web sites like Facebook. Social media has also become more popular than traditional television for people to consume news. These patterns have led to an interest in false news and methods of detection used by researchers. The main idea of this study was to categorize false information on social media that contained text (Text categorization). Four traditional approaches were used: Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency Count Vector Character-level vector N-gram level vector. These methods were applied to the fake news dataset in order to classify it using various Deep Learning and Machine Learning Classifiers. The results showed that while Deep Learning algorithms like Simple Neural Network had an accuracy of 92.52%, Recurrent Neural Network 89.12%, and Convolutional Neural Network 100%, machine learning algorithms like Random Forest had an accuracy of 93.18%, K-Nearest Neighbour 81.2%, Linear SVM 92.87%, Logistic Regression 92.37%, and Naive Bayes 84.87%.

articleTitle: Image Processing Based Early Breast Cancer Detection in Mammography Images Using GRU and XGBoost Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: One out of every eight women will be affected by breast cancer at some point in their lives, making it one of the most common malignancies in females. The most reliable method for finding breast cancer in its early stages is mammography. Due to the low visibility and weak contrast of mammographic photos, early identification of breast cancer is crucial for effective therapy. As a result of several computer-aided detection approaches, radiologists are now able to make more precise diagnoses. Operating Sequencing is crucial for several tasks, including morphology, preprocessing, segmentation, feature selection, and training models. The suggested method makes use of preprocessing technologies that can enhance mammography, remove noise, and identify pectoral muscles. Using image processing techniques, a digital image can be “segmented” into many layers. Acquiring a precise image of the mass is the goal of the morphological process. Geometric algorithms are employed by the feature selection technique. Training a GRU-XGBoost model requires careful consideration of which features to use. The proposed method outperforms the current gold standard algorithms, GRU and XGBoost, in every respect. The results showed a remarkable improvement, with an accuracy of 95.63%.

articleTitle: Towards Efficient Energy Management of Smart Buildings: A LSTM-AE Based Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Optimal home energy utilization and the development of residential segment renewable energy systems are two problems that might be addressed by interacting energy systems in smart homes. Reduced grid electricity usage, particularly during peak hours, increased economic efficiency, user satisfaction (via power seller/purchaser choice), and consumer engagement in energy management are the primary goals of these energy interactions. Performing preprocessing, feature selection, and model training in the proper order is of the utmost importance. Using these measures for data preparation can lead to erroneous model interpretations or lower model performance. Principal component analysis (PCA) is a well-liked method for feature selection that uses linear transformation to reduce the dimension of data in a high-dimensional feature space. When contrasted with the cutting-edge LSTM and AE, this method seems to be quite innovative. A considerable improvement in accuracy, reaching 97.50%, was demonstrated by the results.

articleTitle: Prediction and Optimization of Life Insurance Prediction Based on FEA and ANN Hybrid Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Underwriting, the process of accepting applicants into an insurance fund and determining their coverage terms, is a crucial aspect of obtaining life insurance. Everyone from the applicant to the underwriting team has a lot of work to do throughout the process. A long application form detailing the applicant's life is required to be filled out. After that, the application will be reviewed by the underwriting group, who will then provide the applicant with coverage options after ranking their risk. Training a model, extracting features, and preparing data all depend on proper order. In data preprocessing, we use data reduction, data cleansing, data normalization, and translation. Improve your algorithm's feature selection performance using CFS by removing noise and useless data. As an unsupervised linear feature extraction method, principal components analysis (PCA) can help minimize data size by identifying features with the most information. When training a FEA-ANN model, feature extraction is an essential step. When compared to ANN and FEA, two state-of-the-art algorithms, the proposed method performs better. According to the results, there was a notable improvement, as the accuracy rate was 96.51%.

articleTitle: Towards a Framework for Supply Chain Financing for Order-Level Risk Prediction: An Innovative Stacked A-GRU Based Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Order financing is changing the game in the banking and financial supply chain industry. It's great for SMEs and opens up new revenue streams for logistics and finance companies. But in order to find the weak spots offered by banks and other financial institutions, companies need to undertake thorough risk assessments right now. Careful timing is crucial for training the model, extracting features, and preprocessing. Outlier identification and missing value handling are the first steps in preprocessing, which also includes normalization and standardization to improve data integrity and reduce unit discrepancies. Principal component analysis makes use of multivariate statistics to aid in feature extraction, guaranteeing effective data representation. Careful consideration of every detail is required during the training of a Stacked-A-GRU model, which follows attribute selection. Impressively outperforming state-of-the-art algorithms SAFE and GRU, the suggested solution achieves a remarkable correctness rating of 97.34%, indicating notable progress in predicting accuracy.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Classification Using UNet Deep Neural Networks from 3D MRI Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: A patient's therapy options and prognosis are both improved by detecting and diagnosing a brain tumor early. Brain tumors can be located and diagnosed with the help of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). In real practice, however, medical personnel rely entirely on their own time and expertise when manually identifying brain tumors from a vast number of MRI scans. These days, medical diagnosis and treatment recommendation systems that use computer-aided expertise are all the rage. Brain tumor detection makes use of a plethora of frameworks based on machine-learning(ML) &deep-learning(DL). The purpose of this research is to present a DL-based approach for effective brain tumor segmentation and classification. The research uses convolutional-neural-networks(CNNs) for tumor classification after volumetric segmentation of MRI-images using the 3D-UNet model. To demonstrate the models' validity, loss and precision plots are provided. We compare the outcomes of several methods described in the literature with the measured performance of the models we offer. When compared to the most recent cutting-edge methods, the proposed work comes out on top.

articleTitle: Predicting Student Dropout Rates in Massive Open Online Courses Using an Attention-Based GCNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: There is a treasure trove of information, insights, and monitoring possibilities in the mountains of student data that colleges collect. Economic growth, employment prospects, competitiveness, and productivity are all hindered by educational failures and school dropout rates, which impact not only higher education institutions but also students, families, and society at large. A systematic technique consisting of three essential steps is followed in this work. The first step is to collect the dataset, and then for each data point, preprocessing methods are put up. Here, we focus on variables like gender, previous academic performance, and sessional marks, and we transform and handle missing values as part of the data selection process. The importance of the feature scores is then determined using a feature selection procedure. Lastly, an Attention-based GCNN method outperforms more traditional methods like GCN and ACNN while training the model.

articleTitle: Clinical Decision Support System for Anemia Identification and Severity Stratification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The research addresses the pervasive challenges faced by anemic individuals globally. This innovative solution goes beyond traditional approaches by incorporating real-time data collection, including critical parameters such as Complete Blood Count (CBC), age, and gender providing a dynamic and holistic view of an individual's health status. The integration of CBC data, coupled with demographic information, enhances the precision of the monitoring process, allowing for a more accurate assessment of anemia risk and severity. The collected real-time data is seamlessly transmitted to a centralized cloud platform, where advanced machine learning models, specifically recurrent neural networks (RNNs), come into play. Trained on a diverse dataset that includes CBC counts, age, and gender, these models excel in capturing temporal patterns and subtle variations associated with anemia. The result is a robust classification system that achieves a remarkable 97% accuracy, facilitating early detection and tailored interventions. By combining real-time data collection with sophisticated machine learning and deep learning models, the proposed system represents a significant advancement in addressing the challenges posed by anemia. This holistic and personalized approach not only ensures timely intervention but also contributes to improved healthcare outcomes for individuals affected by this widespread condition.

articleTitle: An Automatic ATM Card Fraud Detection Using Advanced Security Model Based on AOA-CNN-XGBoost Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The implications of financial fraud are becoming more significant as the risk of it grows. For two main reasons, data mining for the purpose of detecting ATM card fraud is quite difficult. First, datasets about ATM card fraud frequently display significant bias. Second, what constitutes legitimate and fraudulent behavior is defined differently every time. The variables chosen and the sample methods used have a direct bearing on how well ATM card fraud detection algorithms work. Card fraud at ATMs is a major threat to the security of online payment systems and banking. Model training, feature reduction, preprocessing, and procedure selection must all be part of a systematic approach. The importance of preprocessing in avoiding inaccurate model output and keeping data quality high cannot be overstated. As part of the preprocessing step known as feature reduction, correlation-based measures are used to examine feature correlation. After that, the model is trained using AOA-CNN-XGBoost, which produces remarkable outcomes with a 97.13% accuracy rate.

articleTitle: “Comparison of TCP Congestion Control Algorithms: Harnessing the power of Traditional Hybrid and Machine Learning Fusion.”
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Modern evolution of communication technologies have resulted in complexity of network communications. In addition increasing diversity of preferred applications with large number of end users have further exaggerated this complexity. As a result the traditional rule-based Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) congestion control approach have now become absolute to efficiently handle this new type of intricacy. Presently machine learning approach finds a major role in solving TCP congestion issue. Both the traditional TCP congestion control and congestion control by machine learning approach have their own merits and demerits. The traditional TCP have less overhead, faster convergence, and show fairness and hence are practical but not adaptable and flexible to the dynamic environment of the networks[1]. On the other hand the machine learning algorithms are good at adaptability and flexibility but are not practical. This paper presents overview on hybrid modes of TCP congestion control namely (i) Combining more than one traditional rule-based approach, (ii) Combining Traditional rule-based and machine learning-based approach and (iii) The combination of more than one machine learning based approach, in order to overcome the present intricacy in communication networks. The main focus of this overview is to highlight that hybrid mode of TCP with machine learning can be an efficient solution for the present TCP congestion issues.

articleTitle: Efficient Reactive Power Control for Enhance Distribution Systems using Predictive Power Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: An Infrastructure like massive power plants and transmission lines have to be built because of the rise in electricity demand. The planning and operation of power systems, however, have recently tended to focus on making the most of the electricity that is already available. Due to transmission line distance and environment, transmission line loss happens. Predictive Power Control Algorithm (PPCA) is used in the suggested strategy to reduce losses and increases voltage. Proposed strategy has lower losses and voltage fluctuations while enhancing the power factor. Some electric utilities have created three levels to stop voltage decline and enable greater utilization of D-STATCOM reactive power supplies. The system compensator is controlled by the suggested Predictive Power Control Algorithm (PPCA), which also improves system stability and decreases total harmonic distortion (THD) by 6.11 %. Charging systems can bring value and extra services to the functioning of the distribution system, such as voltage regulation, by carefully managing the inverters. The system compensator is controlled by the suggested Predictive Power Control Algorithm (PPCA), which also improves system stability and decreases total harmonic distortion (THD) by 6.11 %. Charging systems can bring value and extra services to the functioning of the distribution system, such as voltage regulation, by carefully managing the inverters.

articleTitle: Earthquake Early Warning System Utilizing an CNN-LSTM-TL Based Method for Detection and Parameters Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The obvious first line of protection against powerful earthquake motion is to reinforce houses and other structures. The goal of real-time earthquake catastrophe prevention, in contrast to real-time seismology, is to mitigate damage while an earthquake is still underway. A disaster preventive measure that can be put into action in real-time in the event of an earthquake requires an early warning system (EEW). In order to avoid disasters, should not rely solely on EEW. The order of preprocessing, feature selection, and training the model must be meticulously followed. The preparation phase includes data encoding and normalization. Feature selection incorporates principal component analysis and linear discriminant analysis. It utilized CNN-LSTM-TL for the model's training. The results demonstrate a remarkable 96.49% accuracy.

articleTitle: A Framework to Query in Natural Language on Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Many dashboards have been developed in contemporary Big Data systems to help business subsidiaries make data-driven decisions. The fact that there is currently no interface that enables business stakeholders to conduct natural language queries directly on the Big Data platform in order to acquire timely insights and information highlights another crucial gap in the quest for efficient natural language querying. The abstract highlights the critical need for a natural language querying system inside the Big Data ecosystem, which would enable non- technical users to engage with and derive insightful information from complicated datasets using ordinary language. Most existing frameworks focus on finding the models best working on structured or unstructured data, this study additionally also focuses on data type. By bridging this gap and developing a user-friendly querying interface, stakeholders can improve data accessibility, speed decision-making processes, and foster a data-driven culture across their organizations. There are several types of files of data sets, types of data, and various algorithms that are used for making a query interface. The data sets can be numeric, textual, or string. The string data can contain a mixture of numeric and textual data. The research essentially shows the working of 2 models with different data sets of different data types: the BERT Model and the Lang chain model. Each model works with different accuracy on different types of data sets and a detailed explanation of the same is provided. The proposed framework successfully utilizes LLMs, namely BERT and Lang Chain to efficiently increase the throughput of queries written by users for databases of multiple data types at a best performance percentage of 91.35 %

articleTitle: An Innovative Method for Short Term Electrical Load Forecasting Based on Adaptive CNN - MRMR Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The importance of precise electric demand forecasting has grown in light of the recent deregulation and privatization of power infrastructure. More accurate predictions, at all scales from end-users to the system as a whole, are required by the new energy market and smart grid paradigm. Social activities, environmental factors, and seasonal components are only a few of the many elements that make electric demand projection challenging. There is a specific order in which preprocessing, feature selection, and training the model must be executed. Using Wold's theorem, a “prototypical” day/week was generated for use in preprocessing filters. Feature extraction is a method that particle swarm optimization use. A CNN-MRMR method was used to train the model. When contrasted with the cutting-edge CNN and MRMR, this method appears to be quite novel. With an accuracy percentage of 97.20 percent, the data showed a significant improvement.

articleTitle: Heart Attack Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The Heart Attack Prediction System (HAPS), a sophisticated technology created to predict and prevent cardiovascular diseases, heart attacks in particular, which continue to be a major source of morbidity and death worldwide is introduced in this study. HAPS combines cutting-edge statistical methods and machine learning algorithms with a wide range of datasets that include important risk variables including age, blood pressure, sugar levels, cholesterol, and heart rate. This all-inclusive method uses physiological indicators in addition to age as a basic demographic element to give a full evaluation of cardiovascular health. To identify complex patterns and correlations among the input parameters, machine learning models such as neural networks, decision trees, and support vector machines are used. To determine the relevance of each parameter in the predictive model, the system goes through a rigorous training and validation process that is supplemented by feature importance analysis. In terms of sensitivity, specificity, and overall accuracy, HAPS shows encouraging results. By means of ongoing optimization and verification on various datasets, the system endeavors to enhance its prognostic efficacy and applicability. The main goal is to provide medical practitioners with a trustworthy instrument for early detection of heart attack risk, enabling proactive intervention and individualized preventative treatments. As HAPS develops, it has the potential to have a substantial influence on public health worldwide by lowering rates of heart related illness and mortality.

articleTitle: Enhancing Student Placement Predictions with a Trans-CLSTM Based Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Enhancing students' employability poses a major hurdle for educational institutions in the present day, considering the intricate nature of educational entities. Institutions are finding ways to leverage technology in order to improve their administrative processes and decision-making capabilities. Providing comprehensive insights into educational processes and entities through advanced data analytics is crucial for a successful strategy. This study emphasises three crucial components: data preprocessing, feature selection, and model training. Data preprocessing is crucial for ensuring that the dataset is well-prepared for analysis. Various feature selection techniques are used to determine the most relevant features for training purposes. The proposed Trans-CLSTM models surpass traditional algorithms like LSTM and CNN, showcasing substantial enhancements in accuracy, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 98.22%. This research adds to the ongoing efforts to improve educational quality and student outcomes using data-driven approaches.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an Automated Turmeric Drying Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: One of the most necessary ingredients for our daily activities is turmeric. The use of turmeric for medical purposes has increased in the contemporary global environment. Due to its antimicrobial properties, turmeric's use in households has rapidly increased. It is used not just to cure cancer but also to defend against foreign microorganisms. As a result, turmeric farming has reached its pinnacle. Exporting and cultivating are difficult tasks. Turmeric passes through several steps after harvesting in order to produce the finished product. The most important stage in deciding the final product's quality is the drying process. The drying process has a significant impact on the turmeric's curcumin level. When turmeric doesn't dry completely, its curcumin concentration is impacted. Everything would be lost if curcumin disappeared. Thus, the drying process is labour-intensive, time-consuming, and expensive. Farmers used to endure hardships in order to continue this drying process. To help farmers a godown system is proposed with the automatic monitoring procedure for drying the turmeric. Polycarbonate sheets, used in the construction of godown's, are designed to absorb more sunlight and prevent it from escaping. A heating coil is installed within the godown to aid drying. 40°C is the ideal temperature for turmeric. Eventually, a temperature sensor and an exhaust will be utilized to keep the godown at this temperature. Both days and nights are spent operating this godown. During the day, the drying process makes use of the natural sunshine, and at night, when the temperature drops, an automated heating coil is activated. This variant quickly increases the heating efficiency to 100%. This godown may be used to dry a variety of vegetables and other food products. It does not adhere to turmeric; instead, the suggested model's efficiency is also attained by adjusting the regulated temperature according to the product type. In every case, it eliminates labour costs and yields significant profits for farmers.

articleTitle: Enhanced Security in Payment Gateways Through Face Detection: An Advanced Approach Using DenseNet 121- BiLSTM Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Because it is one of the most promising applications of image analysis, face recognition has been the subject of intense research and development for many decades. Many modern identification and verification requirements have found a potential new home with the introduction of face recognition (FR) technology. Facial recognition is just one of numerous uses for biometric pattern recognition algorithms. Sequencing is essential for many tasks, including as feature extraction, model training, and preprocessing. Eliminating background noise and obtaining dense vertical edges are part of the preprocessing procedures. Facial feature extraction will be employed to extract features after feature extraction. Use attributes cautiously when training a Desnet121-BiLSTM model. In every respect, the suggested method outperforms two state-of-the-art algorithms, Desnet121 and BiLSTM. An accuracy rating of 97.19% was indicative of a considerable improvement in the figures.

articleTitle: Modeling and Prediction of Human Behavior Based on KD-CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: A person's feelings and thoughts about a communication robot have a significant impact on how the two connect. Robots that are both effective and sympathetic must first have a firm grasp of these emotional dynamics. The complex relationship between people's feelings, thoughts, and actions in relation to robots is investigated in this empirical study. Preprocessing input, selecting features, and sequencing are the three main steps in training a model. The Iliou preprocessing method improves the quality of the original data by creating a refined dataset from it. Feature selection makes use of principal component analysis (PCA), which finds important features by analyzing class-feature covariance values. In order to train KDCNN models to operate at their best, feature selection must be done effectively. With an impressive accuracy rate of 96.55%, the suggested method outperforms two state-of-the-art algorithms, KD and CNN, according to the comparative research. More intuitive and responsive robotic systems can be created as a result of this research, which adds to our knowledge of the dynamics of human-robot interaction.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Diabetic Foot Ulcer Prediction: Pedographic Classification Using ELM-PSO
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Most people with diabetes will experience diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs), which are surface sores on the foot, at some point in their diabetes journey. Infection and amputation are among the severe consequences that can result from DFUs that are not addressed. It is critical to discover foot ulcers early because the onset of diabetes is unpredictable. In this regard, the authors of this study offer a model for the purpose of making reliable predictions about the onset of foot ulcers. Model training, feature extraction, and preprocessing are all steps in a sequential process. Using mask-based segmentation, preprocessing improves picture quality and removes noise from the scanned raw RGB images. Training an ELM-PSO model, which outperforms traditional ELM and PSO algorithms, requires careful management of features and uses GLCM for feature extraction. The results show a substantial increase in precision, reaching a mark of 97.15%.

articleTitle: Centralized Monitoring System Street Light Fault Detection and Location Tracking for Smart City
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: In urban settings, where street lighting is essential for safety and security, the proposed system stands as a transformative solution. Through the utilization of IoT technology and cutting-edge fault detection algorithms, it provides a proactive approach to identifying potential issues within the street lighting infrastructure. By continuously monitoring the system, it can swiftly detect problems such as bulb failures, power irregularities, and wiring faults in real-time. This proactive identification not only minimizes downtime but also significantly reduces maintenance costs by addressing issues before they escalate. Furthermore, the integration of GPS modules offers precise location tracking of faulty street lights. This feature enables maintenance crews to efficiently prioritize tasks based on the geographical distribution of issues, optimizing their routes and ensuring timely resolution. Overall, the system's capabilities empower urban authorities to increase the reliability, efficiency, and total effectiveness of street lighting systems, thereby contributing to safer and more sustainable urban environments. By continuously monitoring the performance of street lights and detecting issues promptly, authorities can address maintenance needs more efficiently, minimizing downtime and ensuring consistent lighting levels across urban areas. Moreover, the scalability and adaptability of this system make it well-suited for deployment in various urban settings, from bustling city centers to quieter suburban neighborhoods.

articleTitle: Video Summarization System using NLP and Latent Semantic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: In recent years, automatic captioning of multimedia content, especially videos and audio, has garnered significant attention due to its potential applications in accessibility, content indexing, and human-computer interaction. The proposed paper presents a novel architecture with the integration of Neural networks and Long Short-term Memory (LSTM) via a disintegrator model, the process learns to map a video to a sentence, where encoding is done by the Xception model which is of prima facie and comprises of compression segments into its static representation in the form of feature vectors, Word2Vec function is implemented for better vectorization. The proposed model assigns the respective captions to the audio and the video segments and integrates them accordingly and represents the semantic relation between the words and the summarized captions. Caption's similarity, fluency, accuracy as well as precision are checked with parameters such as BLEU, METEOR, CIDER, and ROUGE. This approach advances the field of multimedia recommendation models also providing aid to the visually impaired. The model is effectively able to capture both the spatial and the temporal features from video frames and the audio segments. The model also showcases the use of sound effects provided in video to generate concise captions using a novel audio captioning architecture.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Risk of Heart Disease Using Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease is a prevalent worldwide occurrence. The accurate identification of this matter holds significant importance for individuals. Cardiac disease advances gradually as a result of the buildup of plaque in the heart, leading to a partial obstruction of blood flow. Cholesterol, calcium, and fibrin are the principal constituents of this plaque. Cardiovascular illness is essential for the flow of oxygenated blood in the human body, facilitating its supply to the heart for pumping. However, the probability of its occurrence can be reduced through meticulous research and timely prediction. The present work investigates the potential application of deep learning methodologies in the early detection and prediction of heart illness. The principal objective of this educational initiative is to accurately ascertain the presence or absence of cardiovascular ailments in an individual. Early-stage forecasting can make use of deep learning approaches, including convolutional neural networks (CNN), multilayer perceptron's, artificial neural networks, and recurrent neural networks. RNN s provide greater classification performance in comparison to other approaches among these strategies.

articleTitle: Risk Modelling and Prediction of Financial Management Using FTL-CSGRU Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: The need of building information technology is becoming more evident to those working in corporate financial management as the digital era arrives. An increasing number of modern societies are using enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems for their financial management needs. That way, companies can collect financial data in real-time and analyze it later. The steps of preprocessing, feature extraction, and training the model are all sequentially laid out. When it comes to statistical approaches used for data preprocessing, z-score normalization, decimal scaling, and min-max all offer very accurate results. You get the greatest results with MCML when you compare it to NCA, PCA, and Cluster-cluster LDA, the four approaches that comprise feature extraction. The suggested method employed an FTL-CSGRU strategy for model training. This method seems antiquated in comparison to the cutting-edge FTL and GRU. The statistics showed a significant improvement with an accuracy rating of 97.36%.

articleTitle: An Extensive study on Energy Efficient Clustering and Routing Protocols in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Over the course of the last several decades, a significant amount of research effort has been carried out to construct wireless sensor networks (WSN) for a broad range of applications. These applications include monitoring agriculture, environment, healthcare, military applications and many more. At present, academics and researchers are focusing on finding solutions to a variety of research problems that are associated with this technological sector. A few of the challenges that researchers must overcome include the development of low-cost and low-power mobile devices, network topologies, deployment techniques, and data routing protocols that are efficient in terms of energy consumption respectively. There has already been a significant amount of research conducted in each of the aforementioned domains on their own, but there are only a handful of research publications or pieces of literature that detail study work that has been conducted in two or more areas simultaneously. Only the simulation work is investigated in the current body of literature, and only a few authors have described the whole design, development, and deployment of WSN. This article provides a comprehensive overview in the form of a literature review, beginning with the design of the mote and finishing with the application that is linked with WSN.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Ensemble Framework for Disaster Tweet Categorization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: In the contemporary landscape, Twitter has evolved into an omnipresent platform, serving diverse functions ranging from expressing movie reviews to swiftly disseminating breaking news, notably in the crucial domain of disaster reporting. The ubiquity of smartphones empowers individuals to share immediate and firsthand disaster observations, while institutions like Disaster Relief Organizations and News Agencies strategically deploy Twitter for systematic and automated monitoring. This proactive strategy enables rapid global disaster identification and response, facilitating well-informed decision-making. Twitter stands as an indispensable tool in the lives of the general public, acting as a primary medium for both information dissemination and disaster reporting. The inherent challenge lies in distinguishing between informative and non-informative disaster announcements amid the vast array of tweets. This challenge is compounded by the sheer volume of information and the need for swift and accurate identification. To confront this challenge, sophisticated methodologies are employed, leveraging advanced technologies such as machine learning, deep learning, and ensemble approaches that integrate both modalities. Tweets are categorized into informative or non-informative classes using machine learning models. Additionally, deep learning models like BERT are employed for their ability to capture intricate contextual nuances in language. Leveraging ensemble learning techniques, which amalgamate the capabilities of various models, significantly improves the effectiveness of disaster monitoring on the Twitter platform. Ensemble learning, through methods like stacking and voting, helps in optimizing performance by considering diverse perspectives and mitigating the limitations of individual models. This comprehensive approach not only enhances public safety but also fortifies global disaster response capabilities, elevating the precision and efficiency of tweet classification. The integration of ensemble learning techniques reflects a strategic approach to finding optimal performance in differentiating between disaster-related tweets that convey information and those that do not on Twitter.

articleTitle: CNN-Enhanced Speech Emotion Recognition with Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) plays a pivotal role in enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of human-computer interaction (HCI). Understanding and interpreting emotional cues from speech signals enable a more natural and intuitive exchange between humans and machines. This project focuses on leveraging datasets from diverse sources, including RAVDESS, TESS, SA VEE, and CREMA, to develop a robust 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model. Employing Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC) features, the model extracts pertinent information from speech signals. After rig-orous training and testing, the presented model demonstrated notable accuracy metrics, reaching 99% accuracy on the training dataset and 96.50 % accuracy on the test dataset. These results underscore the model's adeptness in identifying and categorizing emotional states conveyed through speech. The high accuracy suggests the potential for practical applications in real-world scenarios, particularly in the realm of human-computer interfaces. Moreover, the developed SER model has promising implications for speech-based recommendations. By accurately discerning emotional nuances in speech, the model can serve as a foundation for creating recommendation systems that cater to users' emotional states. The integration of such emotionally aware systems can significantly enhance user experience and engagement. This capability opens avenues for personalized recommendations, tailoring suggestions based not only on user preferences but also on their current emotional context.

articleTitle: Perceived Stress Prediction among Working Employees Based on CAT-DCNN Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: Nowadays, stress diseases affect a large portion of the IT workforce. Workers are more likely to experience stress as a result of evolving work cultures and ways of living. Workplace mental health is still a major issue, despite many efforts by businesses and other organizations to address the issue. The primary objective of it is to determine the causes of the high rates of stress experienced by working-age adults by analyzing their stress patterns. Preprocessing, feature selection, and training the model all rely on sequence. When getting data ready to use in data mining methods, a series of procedures known as “data preprocessing for data mining” is employed. Spearman correlation analysis is employed in feature selection. When training a CAT-DCNN model, feature selection is paramount. When compared to two cutting-edge algorithms, CAT and DCNN, the proposed method comes out on top. With a precision of 97.41%, the results showed a remarkable improvement.

articleTitle: Developing an Advanced IoT-Enabled Smart Agriculture Management System to Enhance Crop Growth: A GBRT-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electronics, Computing, Communication and Control Technology (ICECCC)
abstract: An innovation in today's digital age, the internet of things (IoT) enables a wide range of devices to establish connections with one another, automate and control operations remotely, and share data wirelessly. The IoT has several benefits for agricultural framework implementation, including improved crop monitoring and management. A sequential layout is provided for the phases of preprocessing, segmentation, feature extraction, and model training. Applied during the preprocessing phase to enhance photographs of varying sizes and reduce noise in RGB images. The model is able to correctly identify diseased plant leaves in images by employing iterative computation. The term for this method is leaf image segmentation. The efficient and simple K-means algorithm has seen heavy use in feature extraction. This model was trained using a TL-BiGRU-CRF method. Compared to state-of-the-art CRF and BiGRU, this approach looks dated. With an astounding accuracy percentage of 97.65%, the data clearly indicate a considerable enhancement.
